moscow50-u222562b3a6adcb763f-1.text: ON MUNICIPAL SERVICE IN THE CITY OF MOSCOW

moscow50-u663ed2819e42bdeb5f-1.text: This Law governs relations connected with the organization of municipal service in the City of Moscow; entry into municipal service by citizens of the Russian Federation and by citizens of foreign states that are parties to international treaties of the Russian Federation under which foreign citizens may perform municipal service (hereinafter, citizens); the conditions and procedure for performing and terminating municipal service; and the determination of the legal position (status) of municipal servants of intra-city municipal entities in the City of Moscow (hereinafter, municipal servants). This Law does not determine the status of holders of municipal offices, because they are not municipal servants.

moscow50-u0a748c6a6718f31585-1.text: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law
moscow50-u0a748c6a6718f31585-1.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law

moscow50-u27e91dfc3ffbea1618-1.text: 1. Municipal service in the City of Moscow (hereinafter, municipal service) means citizens’ professional activity carried out on an ongoing basis in municipal service positions filled through the conclusion of an employment agreement (contract).
moscow50-u27e91dfc3ffbea1618-1.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law

moscow50-ucb9c0a99facaf8cbb6-1.text: 2. The employer of a municipal servant is an intra-city municipal entity in the City of Moscow (hereinafter, a municipal entity), on whose behalf the employer’s powers are exercised by the employer’s representative (employer).
moscow50-ucb9c0a99facaf8cbb6-1.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law

moscow50-u07218b2854f0bdab95-1.text: 3. The employer’s representative (employer) means the head of a municipal entity, the head of the administration of a municipal entity (hereinafter, the head of administration), the head of the administrative office of the Council of Deputies of a municipal entity, the Chairperson of the representative body of a municipal entity (hereinafter, the Chairperson of the representative body), or another person authorized to perform the duties of the employer’s representative (employer) under the charter of the municipal entity.
moscow50-u07218b2854f0bdab95-1.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law

moscow50-u553ca6aa6aa76c1d18-1.text: 4. A municipal service position means a position in a local self-government body of a municipal entity (hereinafter, a local self-government body) provided for by the municipal entity’s charter, with an established set of duties to support the exercise of the powers of the local self-government body or a holder of municipal office, and responsibility for exercising those powers.
moscow50-u553ca6aa6aa76c1d18-1.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law

moscow50-ua01e8067212a7f6758-1.text: 5. Holders of municipal offices mean deputies of representative bodies, members of other elected local self-government bodies, and elected local self-government officials in the City of Moscow.
moscow50-ua01e8067212a7f6758-1.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law

moscow50-ub83c68c1f1d590e931-1.text: 6. A municipal servant means a citizen who, in the procedure determined by the charter of the municipal entity and municipal legal acts in accordance with federal legislation and the laws of the City of Moscow, performs the duties of a municipal service position in return for monetary remuneration paid from the budget of the municipal entity (hereinafter, the local budget). Persons performing technical support duties for the activities of local self-government bodies do not hold municipal service positions and are not municipal servants.
moscow50-ub83c68c1f1d590e931-1.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law

moscow50-uabf63591f7a0d4b49f-1.text: 7. The register of municipal service positions means a list of the titles of municipal service positions classified by local self-government body, position group and functional characteristics. The register may provide for municipal service positions established to directly support the exercise of the powers of a holder of municipal office; such positions are filled by municipal servants through the conclusion of an employment agreement (contract) for the term of office of that person.
moscow50-uabf63591f7a0d4b49f-1.locator: Article 1. Main terms used in this Law

moscow50-uc006959d3109960363-1.text: Article 2. Legal foundations of municipal service
moscow50-uc006959d3109960363-1.locator: Article 2. Legal foundations of municipal service

moscow50-ue67085f6794351d05b-1.text: 1. Municipal service is performed in accordance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation; Federal Law No. 131-ФЗ of 6 October 2003 “On the General Principles of the Organization of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation” and Federal Law No. 25-ФЗ of 2 March 2007 “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”; other federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation; the Charter of the City of Moscow; Law of the City of Moscow No. 56 of 6 November 2002 “On the Organization of Local Self-Government in the City of Moscow”; this Law and other normative legal acts of the City of Moscow; municipal entities’ charters and other municipal legal acts.
moscow50-ue67085f6794351d05b-1.locator: Article 2. Legal foundations of municipal service

moscow50-uca1069f1bd4dff39eb-1.text: 2. Labour legislation applies to municipal servants, subject to the special provisions of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”.
moscow50-uca1069f1bd4dff39eb-1.locator: Article 2. Legal foundations of municipal service

moscow50-u1041017a904333c025-1.text: Municipal service is based on the following principles:

moscow50-uc1b85354bbf3a7c528-1.text: 1) priority of human and civil rights and freedoms;

moscow50-u42b4dfd60198b193e1-1.text: 2) supremacy of the Constitution of the Russian Federation and federal laws over other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, and of the laws of the City of Moscow over other normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and municipal legal acts;

moscow50-u15f15bac4824f09353-1.text: 3) equal access to municipal service for citizens proficient in the state language of the Russian Federation, in accordance with their abilities and professional training, and equal conditions of service regardless of sex, race, ethnicity, origin, property and official status, place of residence, attitude to religion, beliefs, membership of public associations or other circumstances unrelated to a municipal servant’s professional and work-related qualities;

moscow50-u73994971f1324a7401-1.text: 4) professionalism and competence of municipal servants;

moscow50-ud25c4867c759dc8ade-1.text: 6) openness and accessibility of information about municipal servants’ activities;

moscow50-uc6a38577ad32dd8488-1.text: 7) interaction with public associations and citizens;

moscow50-u7be3c5a6f88ceaebdb-1.text: 8) uniformity of the basic requirements for municipal service;

moscow50-ufb3a9a1bc2539c6b13-1.text: 9) legal and social protection of municipal servants;

moscow50-u12c766f63225e7e18d-1.text: 10) responsibility of municipal servants for failure to perform or improper performance of their official duties;

moscow50-ude3ff1f2ecac369d59-1.text: 11) independence of local self-government bodies within their powers;

moscow50-u912b5c82b59247dd2b-1.text: 12) interconnection and correspondence between the basic conditions of municipal service and state civil service of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, state civil service);

moscow50-uf198f48c42824653e9-1.text: Article 4. Cooperation between bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow and local self-government bodies on the organization and management of municipal service
moscow50-uf198f48c42824653e9-1.locator: Article 4. Cooperation between bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow and local self-government bodies on the organization and management of municipal service

moscow50-u3f419adbf98bf3925a-1.text: Bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow cooperate with local self-government bodies on the organization and management of municipal service, including:
moscow50-u3f419adbf98bf3925a-1.locator: Article 4. Cooperation between bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow and local self-government bodies on the organization and management of municipal service

moscow50-u182593a805258d8e89-1.text: 1) implementing local self-government development programmes in the City of Moscow;
moscow50-u182593a805258d8e89-1.locator: Article 4. Cooperation between bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow and local self-government bodies on the organization and management of municipal service

moscow50-u4d58fdc78235a0aca2-1.text: 2) studying and analysing the personnel composition of local self-government bodies;
moscow50-u4d58fdc78235a0aca2-1.locator: Article 4. Cooperation between bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow and local self-government bodies on the organization and management of municipal service

moscow50-uefe97c7a31973ad629-1.text: 3) organizing the provision of additional professional education to municipal servants.
moscow50-uefe97c7a31973ad629-1.locator: Article 4. Cooperation between bodies of state authority of the City of Moscow and local self-government bodies on the organization and management of municipal service

moscow50-u6ddc061331d871bb5f-1.text: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service
moscow50-u6ddc061331d871bb5f-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service

moscow50-uc411cd17f22affef2d-1.text: The powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service include:
moscow50-uc411cd17f22affef2d-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service

moscow50-uca62001afaae8a762d-1.text: 1) ensuring compliance with municipal service legislation;
moscow50-uca62001afaae8a762d-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service

moscow50-u24aba109d31edce459-1.text: 2) advising municipal servants on their legal position and on guarantees associated with municipal service;
moscow50-u24aba109d31edce459-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service

moscow50-u3ab51ae9f7dc241ad4-1.text: 3) forming a personnel reserve for municipal service positions in cases provided for by municipal legal acts;
moscow50-u3ab51ae9f7dc241ad4-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service

moscow50-u4b079804e8957d987d-1.text: 4) maintaining a register of municipal servants of local self-government bodies;
moscow50-u4b079804e8957d987d-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service

moscow50-u5ef5c0e8e6ee660f55-1.text: 5) organizing the provision of additional professional education to municipal servants;
moscow50-u5ef5c0e8e6ee660f55-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service

moscow50-ufbc3dbc7475ae832a3-1.text: 6) resolving other matters related to the organization and management of municipal service in accordance with federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, and laws and other normative legal acts of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-ufbc3dbc7475ae832a3-1.locator: Article 5. Powers of local self-government bodies concerning the organization and management of municipal service

moscow50-u8ee84a8d60776d9910-1.text: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service
moscow50-u8ee84a8d60776d9910-1.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service

moscow50-u8b86986aacc177d4d4-1.text: The relationship between municipal service and state civil service is ensured through:
moscow50-u8b86986aacc177d4d4-1.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service

moscow50-u95f7c7c730314ba4c4-1.text: 1) uniform basic qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions and state civil service positions;
moscow50-u95f7c7c730314ba4c4-1.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service

moscow50-u7b3579e4317c102d52-1.text: 2) uniform restrictions and obligations in the performance of municipal service and state civil service;
moscow50-u7b3579e4317c102d52-1.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service

moscow50-uac3bd744a5902d289b-1.text: 3) uniform requirements for the training of personnel for municipal service and state civil service, and for additional professional education;
moscow50-uac3bd744a5902d289b-1.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service

moscow50-u8ca6cd43158ca0830d-1.text: 4) counting length of municipal service when calculating length of state civil service, and counting length of state civil service when calculating length of municipal service;
moscow50-u8ca6cd43158ca0830d-1.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service

moscow50-u34b024dfa79efd6050-1.text: 5) comparability of the basic conditions of remuneration and social guarantees for municipal servants and state civil servants;
moscow50-u34b024dfa79efd6050-1.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service

moscow50-uaf3c06b7f9b8990639-1.text: 6) comparability of the basic conditions of state pension provision for citizens who have performed municipal service and citizens who have performed state civil service, and for members of their families in the event of the loss of a breadwinner.
moscow50-uaf3c06b7f9b8990639-1.locator: Article 6. Relationship between municipal service and state civil service

moscow50-u5992993e85b44dc754-1.text: 1. Municipal service positions are established by municipal legal acts in accordance with the register of municipal service positions approved by this Law.

moscow50-u15638a5184fba7eab5-1.text: 2. When drawing up and approving the staffing schedule of a local self-government body, the titles of municipal service positions specified in the register of municipal service positions are used.

moscow50-ub154af4d24ac81ea2b-1.text: 3. Positions that are not municipal service positions may be included in the staffing schedule to provide technical support for the activities of a local self-government body.

moscow50-ufc84cf87fa3086a31a-1.text: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow
moscow50-ufc84cf87fa3086a31a-1.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow

moscow50-u7f622aaa5069333546-1.text: 1. The register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow is approved by this Law (Appendix 5).
moscow50-u7f622aaa5069333546-1.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow

moscow50-ubb872394c018394805-1.text: 2. Municipal service positions are divided into the following groups:
moscow50-ubb872394c018394805-1.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow

moscow50-u65453b84ee40c95561-1.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow

moscow50-u020076e4f795103f56-1.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow

moscow50-ufe9089ebba57cce646-1.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow

moscow50-u41c9714d7e6b15c5d1-1.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow

moscow50-u3f445968bf4a731586-1.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow

moscow50-u48cbc3b5f1b9ecb95e-1.text: 3. A dual title for a municipal service position is permitted where the following duties are assigned:
moscow50-u48cbc3b5f1b9ecb95e-1.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow

moscow50-ufe48445a6008093c45-1.text: 1) the duties of chief accountant to the head of a structural subdivision of a local self-government body;
moscow50-ufe48445a6008093c45-1.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow

moscow50-u50d0c5b24a4b2b839a-1.text: 2) the duties of accountant to the relevant specialist of a local self-government body;
moscow50-u50d0c5b24a4b2b839a-1.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow

moscow50-u6019a1848a487ff9f4-1.text: 3) the duties of legal adviser to the relevant specialist of a local self-government body.
moscow50-u6019a1848a487ff9f4-1.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow

moscow50-u8f0d6347b661aa09fc-1.text: 4. In the cases specified in part 3 of this Article, municipal service position titles begin with “chief accountant”, “accountant” or “legal adviser”. The status and monetary remuneration of holders of these positions are determined by the second component of the municipal service position title.
moscow50-u8f0d6347b661aa09fc-1.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow

moscow50-ucb8f77ad2df8303c27-1.text: 5. Municipal service position titles may be made more specific by adding designations indicating their specialization.
moscow50-ucb8f77ad2df8303c27-1.locator: Article 8. Register of municipal service positions in the City of Moscow

moscow50-u38b3fda30874cd970e-1.text: Article 9. Correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions
moscow50-u38b3fda30874cd970e-1.locator: Article 9. Correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions

moscow50-ufdd940978eb19a8100-1.text: Taking account of qualification requirements, municipal service positions correspond to state civil service positions as follows:
moscow50-ufdd940978eb19a8100-1.locator: Article 9. Correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions

moscow50-uaef109dae3dc0f6e2a-1.text: 1) highest and principal municipal service positions correspond to principal state civil service positions;
moscow50-uaef109dae3dc0f6e2a-1.locator: Article 9. Correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions

moscow50-u7abb78b6566efaded0-1.text: 2) leading municipal service positions correspond to leading state civil service positions;
moscow50-u7abb78b6566efaded0-1.locator: Article 9. Correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions

moscow50-ud894b9637664389714-1.text: 3) senior municipal service positions correspond to senior state civil service positions;
moscow50-ud894b9637664389714-1.locator: Article 9. Correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions

moscow50-u8b649a483c3b7029e2-1.text: 4) junior municipal service positions correspond to junior state civil service positions.
moscow50-u8b649a483c3b7029e2-1.locator: Article 9. Correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions

moscow50-u7a2fdb1220e541aa00-1.text: Article 10. Qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
moscow50-u7a2fdb1220e541aa00-1.locator: Article 10. Qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions

moscow50-ud2180ef3a521257d14-1.text: 1. To fill a municipal service position, a person must meet the qualification requirements for the level of professional education and the knowledge and skills necessary to perform official duties, and, where the employer’s representative (employer) has made the relevant decision, requirements concerning specialty and field of training.
moscow50-ud2180ef3a521257d14-1.locator: Article 10. Qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions

moscow50-u5ddfbf76b49980ddb1-1.text: 2. Qualification requirements for the level of professional education necessary to fill municipal service positions are established by municipal legal acts on the basis of the standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions determined by this Law in accordance with the register of municipal service positions. Qualification requirements for the knowledge and skills necessary to perform official duties are established in a municipal servant’s job description according to the field and type of their professional service activity. A municipal servant’s job description may also specify qualification requirements concerning specialty and field of training.
moscow50-u5ddfbf76b49980ddb1-1.locator: Article 10. Qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions

moscow50-u3880a904f9f1636600-1.text: 2.1. No qualification requirements concerning length of municipal service or work experience in a specialty or field of training are imposed for filling municipal service positions.
moscow50-u3880a904f9f1636600-1.locator: Article 10. Qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions

moscow50-u9031c37ad14de46525-1.text: 3. Where a person is appointed as head of administration under a contract, a law of the City of Moscow and the charter of the municipal entity may establish additional requirements for candidates for that position.
moscow50-u9031c37ad14de46525-1.locator: Article 10. Qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions

moscow50-u95d473160b90de233f-1.text: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions
moscow50-u95d473160b90de233f-1.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions

moscow50-u76464dfec8c08b1204-1.text: 1. To fill a municipal service position, a person must meet the following qualification requirements:
moscow50-u76464dfec8c08b1204-1.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions

moscow50-u7b348e48ee941abb39-1.text: 1) concerning the level of professional education:
moscow50-u7b348e48ee941abb39-1.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions

moscow50-u38d5917ff95e772fea-1.text: а) higher education for highest, principal, leading and senior municipal service positions;
moscow50-u38d5917ff95e772fea-1.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions

moscow50-ub67aae9c528d01dc38-1.text: б) secondary vocational education for junior municipal service positions;
moscow50-ub67aae9c528d01dc38-1.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions

moscow50-u37c2d8eeaa5aed5e8b-1.text: 2) repealed by Law of the City of Moscow No. 2 of 29.01.2020.
moscow50-u37c2d8eeaa5aed5e8b-1.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions

moscow50-u896c465e2b7a4eb999-1.text: 2. Repealed by Law of the City of Moscow No. 19 of 16.04.2025.
moscow50-u896c465e2b7a4eb999-1.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions

moscow50-u52aad7358d8e9aebb6-1.text: 3. Repealed by Law of the City of Moscow No. 34 of 16.09.2009.
moscow50-u52aad7358d8e9aebb6-1.locator: Article 11. Standard qualification requirements for filling municipal service positions

moscow50-u9bfad20cf422eb5b67-1.text: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant
moscow50-u9bfad20cf422eb5b67-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-u8b7d523c74d7aed64c-1.text: 1. A municipal servant has the right to:
moscow50-u8b7d523c74d7aed64c-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-u6351638219c7a536a1-1.text: 1) familiarize themselves with documents establishing their rights and duties in the municipal service position held, criteria for evaluating the quality of performance of official duties, and conditions for promotion;
moscow50-u6351638219c7a536a1-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-u4f6d66929245caf699-1.text: 2) the organizational and technical support necessary to perform official duties;
moscow50-u4f6d66929245caf699-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-u17c0f3496dcd544551-1.text: 3) receive remuneration and other payments in accordance with labor legislation, municipal service legislation and the employment agreement (contract);
moscow50-u17c0f3496dcd544551-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-u6edcf0968ed6a7a0d9-1.text: 4) rest, ensured through standard working (service) hours, days off and non-working public holidays, and annual paid leave;
moscow50-u6edcf0968ed6a7a0d9-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-ucde3882cef5a436499-1.text: 5) obtain, according to the established procedure, information and materials necessary to perform official duties, and submit proposals to improve the activities of the local self-government body;
moscow50-ucde3882cef5a436499-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-uebda9d3f1cafce02b4-1.text: 6) participate, on their own initiative, in a competition to fill a vacant municipal service position;
moscow50-uebda9d3f1cafce02b4-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-u2f196243a47730920c-1.text: 7) receive additional professional education in accordance with a municipal legal act at the expense of the local budget;
moscow50-u2f196243a47730920c-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-uec1781ad9bd5968a04-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-uaf9d72139cc0828763-1.text: 9) familiarize themselves with all materials in their personal file and with assessments of their professional activity and other documents before they are placed in that file, and have their written explanations added to the file;
moscow50-uaf9d72139cc0828763-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-u666afea48078c2d4bf-1.text: 10) freedom of association, including the right to form trade unions to protect their rights and socioeconomic and professional interests;
moscow50-u666afea48078c2d4bf-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-u57bfe8729122d8c57a-1.text: 11) consideration of individual labour disputes in accordance with labour legislation, and protection of their rights and legitimate interests in municipal service;
moscow50-u57bfe8729122d8c57a-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-u3da1ab02346dbc3a87-1.text: 12) an official investigation, conducted at their request, to refute information connected with their municipal service that discredits their honour and dignity;
moscow50-u3da1ab02346dbc3a87-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-u706ecab0ae331a4232-1.text: 13) visiting, in the prescribed procedure, bodies of state authority and state bodies of the City of Moscow, local self-government bodies, organizations irrespective of their organizational and legal forms, and public associations in the City of Moscow;
moscow50-u706ecab0ae331a4232-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-uf497f89c3ef9e0e5bd-1.text: 14) pension provision in accordance with federal law.
moscow50-uf497f89c3ef9e0e5bd-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-u35473c450ddc3e8fdb-1.text: 2. A municipal servant, other than a municipal servant holding the position of head of administration under a contract, may perform other paid work after giving prior written notice to the employer’s representative (employer), provided this does not give rise to a conflict of interest and unless otherwise provided by federal legislation and this Law.
moscow50-u35473c450ddc3e8fdb-1.locator: Article 12. Basic rights of a municipal servant

moscow50-ued5df9dce24b429047-1.text: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant
moscow50-ued5df9dce24b429047-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-ub2974093b0544e9039-1.text: 1. A municipal servant is obliged to:
moscow50-ub2974093b0544e9039-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-u604fd0516438888166-1.text: 1) comply with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, the Charter of the City of Moscow, laws and other normative legal acts of the City of Moscow, the charter of the municipal entity and other municipal legal acts;
moscow50-u604fd0516438888166-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-uf018d15f6cc79b58a1-1.text: 2) conscientiously perform official duties in accordance with the job description;
moscow50-uf018d15f6cc79b58a1-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-u4495a06711783cc077-1.text: 3) when performing official duties, respect human and civil rights, freedoms and legitimate interests regardless of race, ethnicity, language, attitude to religion or other circumstances, as well as the rights and legitimate interests of organizations;
moscow50-u4495a06711783cc077-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-ubb62d5d33be84f0c58-1.text: 4) carry out instructions given by the relevant managers within their powers;
moscow50-ubb62d5d33be84f0c58-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-uf072c0977f2744727a-1.text: 5) consider citizens’ appeals in a timely manner and take decisions on them in accordance with federal law;
moscow50-uf072c0977f2744727a-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-uf884dcab37cea599f4-1.text: 6) comply with the internal labour rules, job description, procedures for handling official information and documents, and standards of official ethics established in the local self-government body;
moscow50-uf884dcab37cea599f4-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-uaf675634132bb179d8-1.text: 7) maintain a level of qualification sufficient for the proper performance of their official duties;
moscow50-uaf675634132bb179d8-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-ucc84aade4e24b604d6-1.text: 8) not disclose information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal laws, or information learned in connection with the performance of official duties, including information concerning citizens’ private lives and health or affecting their honor and dignity;
moscow50-ucc84aade4e24b604d6-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-u6d51ce7a1afdb20c19-1.text: 9) safeguard state and municipal property, including property provided for the performance of official duties;
moscow50-u6d51ce7a1afdb20c19-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-u64b5e998b5dc695f21-1.text: 10) submit, in the prescribed procedure, information about themselves and members of their family required by federal legislation;
moscow50-u64b5e998b5dc695f21-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-uebd303e6da983d2c95-1.text: 11) notify the employer’s representative (employer) in writing of the termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state that is a party to an international treaty of the Russian Federation under which a foreign citizen is entitled to serve in municipal service, on the day the municipal servant learns of this, but no later than five working days after the termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or citizenship (subjecthood) of such a foreign state that is a party to an international treaty of the Russian Federation under which a foreign citizen is entitled to serve in municipal service;
moscow50-uebd303e6da983d2c95-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-uc3246fb6694352de42-1.text: 11.1) notify the employer’s representative (employer) in writing of acquiring citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state or receiving a residence permit or another document confirming the citizen’s right to permanent residence in a foreign state, on the day the municipal servant learns of this, but no later than five working days after acquiring that citizenship (subjecthood) or receiving that residence permit or other document confirming the right to permanent residence in a foreign state;
moscow50-uc3246fb6694352de42-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-u49ebfaf594843df4fe-1.text: 12) comply with restrictions, fulfil obligations and observe prohibitions established by federal legislation;
moscow50-u49ebfaf594843df4fe-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-uce765dc298333f54cc-1.text: 13) notify the employer’s representative (employer) in writing of any personal interest in the performance of official duties that may lead to a conflict of interest, and take measures to prevent such a conflict;
moscow50-uce765dc298333f54cc-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-u20880af5404b799f62-1.text: 14) take measures to prevent conflicts of interest from arising;
moscow50-u20880af5404b799f62-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-u135701fd754dfb1fac-1.text: 15) notify the employer’s representative (employer), prosecution bodies or other state bodies designated by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation of all instances in which any person approaches the municipal servant with the aim of inducing them to commit corruption offences;
moscow50-u135701fd754dfb1fac-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-u7a425426f2e3e93ac9-1.text: 16) inform the employer’s representative (employer) in writing of changes that have come to their attention in information contained in the questionnaire provided for by Article 15.2 of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”, except information that changed as a result of a decision of the employer’s representative (employer) (hereinafter, information contained in the questionnaire).
moscow50-u7a425426f2e3e93ac9-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-u02d3aaf31c762ba76a-1.text: 2. A municipal servant may not carry out an unlawful instruction given to them. Upon receiving an instruction from the relevant manager that the municipal servant considers unlawful, the municipal servant must provide the manager who gave it with a written explanation of its unlawfulness, identifying the provisions of federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, laws and other normative legal acts of the City of Moscow, and municipal legal acts that could be violated by carrying out the instruction. If the manager confirms the instruction in writing, the municipal servant must refuse to carry it out. If an unlawful instruction is carried out, the municipal servant and the manager who gave it are liable under federal legislation.
moscow50-u02d3aaf31c762ba76a-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-ua305a645d8e9a15318-1.text: 3. The employer’s representative (employer) determines the procedure for notifying them of instances in which any person approaches a municipal servant with the aim of inducing them to commit corruption offences, the information to be included in such notifications, the arrangements for verifying that information, and the procedure for registering notifications.
moscow50-ua305a645d8e9a15318-1.locator: Article 13. Basic duties of a municipal servant

moscow50-u1d2876813a77c1c3c8-1.text: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service
moscow50-u1d2876813a77c1c3c8-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u92990e27db0b8232ff-1.text: 1. A citizen may not be admitted to municipal service, and a municipal servant may not remain in municipal service, in the event of:
moscow50-u92990e27db0b8232ff-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u50ffb16d1c4b89e75c-1.text: 1) being declared legally incapable or of limited legal capacity by a court decision that has entered into legal force;
moscow50-u50ffb16d1c4b89e75c-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-uf2513afcfbf3da4c37-1.text: 2) being sentenced to a punishment that precludes performance of the official duties of a municipal service position, or being deprived for a specified period of the right to hold municipal service positions, by a court judgment that has entered into legal force;
moscow50-uf2513afcfbf3da4c37-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-ub959dd958f5216d16f-1.text: 3) refusal to undergo the procedure for obtaining clearance to information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal laws, if the duties of the municipal service position for which the citizen is applying or which the municipal servant holds involve the use of such information;
moscow50-ub959dd958f5216d16f-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u11f47a8d67471e5e9e-1.text: 4) having an illness that prevents entry into or performance of municipal service, confirmed by an opinion of a medical organization. The procedure for preventive medical examinations, the list of such illnesses and the form of the medical organization’s opinion are established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation;
moscow50-u11f47a8d67471e5e9e-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u0feceb82965774de70-1.text: 5) close family relationship or affinity (parents, spouses, children, brothers and sisters, as well as a spouse’s brothers, sisters, parents and children, and children’s spouses) with the head of a municipal entity who heads the administration, where holding the municipal service position entails direct subordination or accountability to that official, or with a municipal servant where holding the position entails direct subordination or accountability of one of them to the other;
moscow50-u0feceb82965774de70-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u0e93708dc838c3e699-1.text: 6) termination of citizenship of the Russian Federation or citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state that is a party to an international treaty of the Russian Federation under which a foreign citizen is entitled to serve in municipal service;
moscow50-u0e93708dc838c3e699-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-udbe55ac70aef51c34e-1.text: 7) holding citizenship (subjecthood) of a foreign state, or a residence permit or another document confirming the right to permanent residence in a foreign state, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or federal legislation;
moscow50-udbe55ac70aef51c34e-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u4d394bf9ef2ed40d7a-1.text: 8) submission, upon entry into municipal service and/or during its performance, of forged documents and/or knowingly false information confirming compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements the violation of which precludes holding a municipal service position, or failure to submit documents and/or information demonstrating noncompliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements the violation of which precludes holding a municipal service position;
moscow50-u4d394bf9ef2ed40d7a-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-ua612112030f57fd47b-1.text: 9) failing to submit information required by the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”, Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 “On Combating Corruption”, other federal laws and this Law, or submitting knowingly inaccurate or incomplete information when entering municipal service;
moscow50-ua612112030f57fd47b-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u94e621f96c8286126e-1.text: 9.1) being found, in accordance with the conclusion of a conscription commission, not to have performed military service by conscription without lawful grounds (except citizens who have performed military service under a contract): for 10 years from the expiry of the period allowed for appealing that conclusion to the conscription commission of the relevant constituent entity of the Russian Federation; or, if that conclusion and/or the decision of that constituent entity’s conscription commission on the citizen’s appeal against the conclusion was challenged in court, for 10 years from the entry into legal force of the court decision finding that the citizen’s rights were not violated when the conclusion and/or the decision of the constituent entity’s conscription commission on the citizen’s appeal against that conclusion was issued;
moscow50-u94e621f96c8286126e-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-ud57efae5d169f05c54-1.text: 10) other cases provided for by federal laws.
moscow50-ud57efae5d169f05c54-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-ub7c364923690667edc-1.text: 1.1. A citizen may not be appointed as head of administration under a contract, and a municipal servant may not hold that position under a contract, where they have a close family relationship or affinity (parents, spouses, children, brothers and sisters, as well as a spouse’s brothers, sisters, parents and children, and children’s spouses) with the head of the municipal entity.
moscow50-ub7c364923690667edc-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u6ff23c1ba4fbc6d9f3-1.text: 1.2. A citizen may not be appointed as chairperson or deputy chairperson of a municipal entity’s control and audit body, and a municipal servant may not hold either position, where they have a close family relationship or affinity (parents, spouses, children, brothers and sisters, as well as a spouse’s brothers, sisters, parents and children, and children’s spouses) with the Chairperson of the representative body, the head of the municipal entity, the head of administration, or the heads of judicial and law-enforcement bodies located in the territory of the relevant municipal entity.
moscow50-u6ff23c1ba4fbc6d9f3-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-uf28b1114a93aac99dd-1.text: 2. The maximum age for holding a municipal service position is 65 years. A citizen may not be admitted to municipal service after reaching that age. The employer’s representative (employer) may extend the service of a municipal servant who has reached the maximum age for holding a municipal service position once, by no more than one year.
moscow50-uf28b1114a93aac99dd-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u57b5ed6abc7023f5e4-1.text: 3. To avoid a conflict of interest, a municipal servant who is the head or deputy head of a local self-government body may not represent municipal servants’ interests in that body’s elected trade union body while holding the relevant position.
moscow50-u57b5ed6abc7023f5e4-1.locator: Article 14. Restrictions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u324e2e55c753d58ab3-1.text: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service
moscow50-u324e2e55c753d58ab3-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-uaae92544da14d65b15-1.text: 1. In connection with municipal service, a municipal servant is prohibited from:
moscow50-uaae92544da14d65b15-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-ucca42342702bb69c39-1.text: 1) repealed by Law of the City of Moscow No. 23 of 13.05.2015;
moscow50-ucca42342702bb69c39-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u5f0864da94b11b13b2-1.text: 2) holding a municipal service position in the event of:
moscow50-u5f0864da94b11b13b2-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u0e8b02be2e4b5069fc-1.text: а) election or appointment to a state office of the Russian Federation, the City of Moscow or another constituent entity of the Russian Federation, or appointment to a position in state service;
moscow50-u0e8b02be2e4b5069fc-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u0f691b2eb35d578c9b-1.text: б) election or appointment to a municipal office in the City of Moscow or another constituent entity of the Russian Federation;
moscow50-u0f691b2eb35d578c9b-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u284578f60e884057b1-1.text: в) election to a paid elective position in a trade union body, including the elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body;
moscow50-u284578f60e884057b1-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u7aa8ec72edef401d34-1.text: 3) participate in managing a commercial or non-commercial organization, except in the cases provided for by point 3 of part 1 of Article 14 of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”;
moscow50-u7aa8ec72edef401d34-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-udfbad3d2ed0897124c-1.text: 3.1) engage in entrepreneurial activity personally or through proxies;
moscow50-udfbad3d2ed0897124c-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u180e55b8b9eb4b2439-1.text: 4) acting as an agent or representative in third-party matters before the local self-government body in which they hold a municipal service position or which is directly subordinate or accountable to them, unless otherwise provided by federal laws;
moscow50-u180e55b8b9eb4b2439-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-uf7f57c029db8a36b74-1.text: 5) receiving rewards from individuals or legal entities in connection with official status or the performance of official duties (gifts, monetary remuneration, loans, services, payment for entertainment, holidays or transport expenses, or other rewards). Gifts received by a municipal servant in connection with protocol events, official business trips or other official events are recognized as municipal property and are transferred by the municipal servant under a transfer record to the local self-government body in which the servant holds a municipal service position, except in cases established by the Civil Code of the Russian Federation. A municipal servant who has surrendered a gift received in connection with a protocol event, official business trip or other official event may purchase it according to the procedure established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation;
moscow50-uf7f57c029db8a36b74-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-uba3e5a1fdbcbff4f34-1.text: 6) undertaking business trips funded by individuals or legal entities, except business trips undertaken on a reciprocal basis by agreement between the local self-government body and local self-government bodies of other municipalities, or with state authorities and local self-government bodies of foreign states or international and foreign nonprofit organizations;
moscow50-uba3e5a1fdbcbff4f34-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u4fc6bc9ad4299a6744-1.text: 7) using material, technical, financial or other support resources, or other municipal property, for purposes unrelated to the performance of official duties;
moscow50-u4fc6bc9ad4299a6744-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u7b4f90c01de47bbfe5-1.text: 8) disclosing, or using for purposes unrelated to municipal service, information classified as confidential under federal laws, or official information, learned in connection with the performance of official duties;
moscow50-u7b4f90c01de47bbfe5-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u6030e975c318b9ed3d-1.text: 9) make public statements, judgments or assessments, including in the media, concerning the activities of local self-government bodies or their heads, where this is not part of their official duties;
moscow50-u6030e975c318b9ed3d-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u2dc7cba376eb5590ba-1.text: 10) accepting, without the written permission of the head of the municipality, awards or honorary or special titles (other than academic titles) from foreign states, international organizations, political parties, other public associations or religious associations, if interaction with those organizations or associations forms part of the servant’s official duties;
moscow50-u2dc7cba376eb5590ba-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u183a5b610a2314b9a3-1.text: 11) using the advantages of official status for election campaigning or campaigning on referendum issues;
moscow50-u183a5b610a2314b9a3-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u91ab8e2293a619f6f7-1.text: 12) using official status in the interests of political parties, religious associations or other public associations, or publicly expressing attitudes toward those associations in the capacity of a municipal servant;
moscow50-u91ab8e2293a619f6f7-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u8aaad487f98206efc7-1.text: 13) establish structures of political parties, religious associations or other public associations within local self-government bodies (except trade unions, veterans’ bodies and other bodies of public self-organization), or facilitate the establishment of such structures;
moscow50-u8aaad487f98206efc7-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u7f01b18e31e2575350-1.text: 14) ceasing to perform official duties for the purpose of resolving a labor dispute;
moscow50-u7f01b18e31e2575350-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u34faca348907ad7985-1.text: 15) serving on governing bodies, boards of trustees, supervisory boards or other bodies of foreign nonprofit nongovernmental organizations or their structural subdivisions operating in the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation;
moscow50-u34faca348907ad7985-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-ua0d4f08822a00a0821-1.text: 16) engage, without written permission from the employer’s representative (employer), in paid activity financed exclusively from the resources of foreign states, international and foreign organizations, foreign citizens and stateless persons, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or federal legislation.
moscow50-ua0d4f08822a00a0821-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-uc57c159c5bec2cebc4-1.text: 1.1. To obtain permission from the employer’s representative (employer) to participate without remuneration in the management of a non-commercial organization in cases where such permission is required under point 3 of part 1 of Article 14 of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”, a municipal servant submits a written application for such permission to the employer’s representative (employer), together with copies of the constituent documents of the non-commercial organization concerned. Within no more than 10 working days after receiving the application, the employer’s representative (employer) considers it and decides either to permit the municipal servant to participate in the management of the non-commercial organization or to refuse permission if such participation could give rise to a conflict of interest. Within three working days of that decision, the employer’s representative (employer) informs the municipal servant of it in writing, against signature. The procedure for considering the application by the employer’s representative (employer) is established by the representative body.
moscow50-uc57c159c5bec2cebc4-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u98f918714baba45b2f-1.text: 2. A municipal servant holding the position of head of administration under a contract may not engage in other paid activity, except teaching, scientific and other creative activity. Such teaching, scientific and other creative activity may not be financed exclusively from the resources of foreign states, international and foreign organizations, foreign citizens and stateless persons, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or federal legislation.
moscow50-u98f918714baba45b2f-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-ud8027b19e6e87639ef-1.text: 2.1. Repealed by Law of the City of Moscow No. 7 of 04.04.2012.
moscow50-ud8027b19e6e87639ef-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u514b702fa75fe4c493-1.text: 2.2. A municipal servant holding the position of head of administration under a contract is prohibited from opening or holding accounts (deposits), keeping cash or valuables in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, and owning and/or using foreign financial instruments.
moscow50-u514b702fa75fe4c493-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-ub5de57524680455981-1.text: 3. After leaving municipal service, a citizen is not entitled to disclose, or use in the interests of organizations or individuals, confidential or official information learned in connection with the performance of official duties.
moscow50-ub5de57524680455981-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-ucadcdf6225478cfc12-1.text: 4. For two years after leaving municipal service, a citizen who held a municipal service position included in a list established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and municipal legal acts may not hold a position in an organization under an employment agreement and/or perform work for that organization under a civil-law contract in the cases provided for by federal laws, where their official (service) duties included certain functions of municipal (administrative) management of that organization, without the consent of the relevant commission on compliance with requirements for the official conduct of municipal servants and settlement of conflicts of interest (hereinafter, the conflict-of-interest settlement commission). Such consent is given in the procedure established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and municipal legal acts.
moscow50-ucadcdf6225478cfc12-1.locator: Article 15. Prohibitions associated with municipal service

moscow50-u74ff89cb234d9a6f67-1.text: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service
moscow50-u74ff89cb234d9a6f67-1.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service

moscow50-u90a0de9b659f8b29ae-1.text: 1. For the purposes of this Law, the terms “conflict of interest” and “personal interest” established by Article 10 of the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption” are used.
moscow50-u90a0de9b659f8b29ae-1.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service

moscow50-u82a502ddb74951e510-1.text: 2. Repealed. — Law of the City of Moscow of 27.01.2016 No. 5.
moscow50-u82a502ddb74951e510-1.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service

moscow50-ub9ad48397d87d03d14-1.text: 2.1. Prevention or resolution of a conflict of interest may consist of changing the official or service position of a municipal servant who is a party to the conflict, up to suspension from the performance of official (service) duties according to the established procedure, and/or the servant’s renunciation of the benefit that caused the conflict of interest.
moscow50-ub9ad48397d87d03d14-1.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service

moscow50-u1d636c2ac9ec25924a-1.text: 2.2. If a person holding a municipal service position owns securities (participatory interests or units in the authorised (contributed) capital of organisations), and this leads or may lead to a conflict of interest, that person must transfer their securities (participatory interests or units in the authorised (contributed) capital of organisations) into trust management in accordance with the civil legislation of the Russian Federation.
moscow50-u1d636c2ac9ec25924a-1.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service

moscow50-udd9c3f1d7cf389a236-1.text: 2.3. Failure by a municipal servant who is a party to a conflict of interest to take measures to prevent or resolve it constitutes an offense resulting in dismissal from municipal service, except in cases established by federal laws.
moscow50-udd9c3f1d7cf389a236-1.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service

moscow50-uddb54fdc64118ae230-1.text: 3. An employer’s representative (employer) who becomes aware that a municipal servant has a personal interest which leads or may lead to a conflict of interest must take measures to prevent or resolve the conflict of interest, up to and including suspension of the municipal servant who is a party to the conflict of interest from the municipal service position held, in the procedure established by this Law.
moscow50-uddb54fdc64118ae230-1.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service

moscow50-u28436b94241153376c-1.text: 3.1. Failure by a municipal servant acting as an employer’s representative (employer), who has become aware that a subordinate municipal servant has a personal interest which leads or may lead to a conflict of interest, to take measures to prevent or resolve the conflict of interest constitutes an offence entailing dismissal from municipal service of the municipal servant acting as the employer’s representative (employer), except in cases established by federal laws.
moscow50-u28436b94241153376c-1.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service

moscow50-udd062ab649fb8bfb3c-1.text: 4. To ensure municipal servants’ compliance with the general principles of official conduct and to resolve conflicts of interest, a commission for resolving conflicts of interest is established in the local self-government body in the procedure determined by normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and municipal legal acts.
moscow50-udd062ab649fb8bfb3c-1.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service

moscow50-u56885afc67ff6aaf60-1.text: 5. The commission for resolving conflicts of interest is established by a municipal legal act. Its membership includes the employer’s representative (employer) and/or municipal servants authorised by that representative (including those from the structural unit in which the municipal servant who is a party to the conflict of interest holds a municipal service position), as well as representatives of scientific and educational organisations and other organisations invited by the employer’s representative (employer) as independent experts specialising in issues related to municipal service, without specifying the experts’ personal data. Independent experts must make up at least one quarter of the total membership of the commission for resolving conflicts of interest.
moscow50-u56885afc67ff6aaf60-1.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service

moscow50-ub997f4cee4eababeb1-1.text: 6. The regulations on the commission for resolving conflicts of interest are approved by the representative body.
moscow50-ub997f4cee4eababeb1-1.locator: Article 16. Settlement of conflicts of interest in municipal service

moscow50-uefdbc9769d5facb361-1.text: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant
moscow50-uefdbc9769d5facb361-1.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant

moscow50-ub2974093b0544e9039-2.text: 1. A municipal servant is obliged to:
moscow50-ub2974093b0544e9039-2.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant

moscow50-u276f093b752ab2df76-1.text: 1) perform official duties conscientiously and to a high professional standard;
moscow50-u276f093b752ab2df76-1.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant

moscow50-ue01e39d412c59adab2-1.text: 2) ensure equal and impartial treatment of all individuals, legal entities and organizations, give no preference to any public or religious associations, professional or social groups, citizens or organizations, and avoid bias toward such associations, groups, organizations and citizens;
moscow50-ue01e39d412c59adab2-1.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant

moscow50-ue6e6b352f23df392d9-1.text: 3) refrain from actions influenced by any personal, property-related (financial) or other interests that hinder conscientious performance of official duties;
moscow50-ue6e6b352f23df392d9-1.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant

moscow50-u2ac00f50ad7f5c7c1e-1.text: 4) maintain neutrality so as to exclude the possibility that decisions of political parties, other public or religious associations or other organizations influence their professional official activities;
moscow50-u2ac00f50ad7f5c7c1e-1.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant

moscow50-u6c234a18ea7d3cc281-1.text: 5) be courteous in dealings with citizens;
moscow50-u6c234a18ea7d3cc281-1.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant

moscow50-uc26eca657cbf3ab033-1.text: 6) respect the moral customs and traditions of the peoples of the Russian Federation;
moscow50-uc26eca657cbf3ab033-1.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant

moscow50-u70a78b5bd563e798a8-1.text: 7) take account of the cultural and other characteristics of different ethnic and social groups and religious denominations;
moscow50-u70a78b5bd563e798a8-1.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant

moscow50-u2e8975097c8049fa9a-1.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant

moscow50-ub05f562b4a157bfef1-1.text: 9) prevent conflict situations capable of damaging their reputation or the authority of the local self-government body.
moscow50-ub05f562b4a157bfef1-1.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant

moscow50-ub9ccfdff8c83034759-1.text: 2. A municipal servant who is a manager is obliged to prevent cases in which municipal servants are compelled to participate in the activities of political parties or other public or religious associations.
moscow50-ub9ccfdff8c83034759-1.locator: Article 16.1. Requirements for the official conduct of a municipal servant

moscow50-ub7134a2a0b90083b04-1.text: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure
moscow50-ub7134a2a0b90083b04-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-ucae2deefb2dffbb739-1.text: 1. A citizen applying for a municipal service position and a municipal servant shall submit to the employer’s representative (employer) information on income, property and property-related obligations provided for by the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption” (hereinafter, information on income, property and property-related obligations), in the cases established by that Federal Law. Such information shall be submitted in the procedure, within the time limits and in the form established for submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations by state civil servants of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-ucae2deefb2dffbb739-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-uef56762e98a5b86373-1.text: 1.1. A municipal servant holding a municipal service position included in the relevant list must submit information on expenditure provided for by Federal Law No. 230-FZ of 3 December 2012 “On Monitoring the Correspondence of Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons to Their Income” (hereinafter, information on expenditure), in the procedure and form established for submission of information on expenditure by state civil servants of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-uef56762e98a5b86373-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-ue03750bc61d5498227-1.text: 1.2. Monitoring the correspondence of a municipal servant’s expenditure and that of their spouse and minor children to their income is carried out in the procedure provided for by the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption” and the Federal Law “On Monitoring the Correspondence of Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons to Their Income”, normative legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation, laws and other normative legal acts of the City of Moscow, and municipal legal acts.
moscow50-ue03750bc61d5498227-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-ucc767f859953b1434c-1.text: 2. Information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure submitted by a municipal servant under this Article are confidential, unless federal laws classify them as information constituting a state secret or another secret protected by federal laws.
moscow50-ucc767f859953b1434c-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-u4dbc0e03f9e1d256f8-1.text: 3. Information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure submitted by a municipal servant under this Article may not be used to establish or determine the solvency of the municipal servant, their spouse or minor children, or to collect, directly or indirectly, donations (contributions) to funds of religious or other public associations, other organisations, or individuals.
moscow50-u4dbc0e03f9e1d256f8-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-u5d6b72b3f08f9ccdd1-1.text: 4. Persons responsible for disclosing information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure submitted by a municipal servant under this Article, or for using that information for purposes not provided for by federal laws, shall be liable in accordance with federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
moscow50-u5d6b72b3f08f9ccdd1-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-u80b8e0ee02233be82e-1.text: 5. A municipal servant’s failure to submit information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure where its submission is mandatory, or submission of knowingly incomplete information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure, constitutes an offence entailing dismissal from municipal service, except in cases established by federal laws.
moscow50-u80b8e0ee02233be82e-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-u0234b29140ed18426f-1.text: 5.1. A municipal servant’s submission of knowingly inaccurate information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure constitutes an offence entailing dismissal from municipal service.
moscow50-u0234b29140ed18426f-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-ua97110a5728e554d2f-1.text: 6. Verification of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure submitted under Parts 1 and 1.1 of this Article by municipal servants holding the specified positions; of the accuracy and completeness of information submitted by citizens entering municipal service in accordance with normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and municipal legal acts; and of municipal servants’ compliance with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and their performance of duties established by the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption”, other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation and this Law is carried out in the procedure determined by normative legal acts of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-ua97110a5728e554d2f-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-u905d74723bfaaf274d-1.text: 7. Requests for information constituting banking, tax or other legally protected secrets, and requests to law enforcement bodies to conduct operational-search measures concerning citizens applying for municipal service positions included in the relevant list, municipal servants holding those positions, and the spouses and minor children of such citizens and municipal servants, are sent in the interests of local self-government bodies by the Mayor of Moscow in the procedure determined by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
moscow50-u905d74723bfaaf274d-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-ud53c80e7919bf4c8fd-1.text: 8. Citizens applying for the position of head of administration under contract shall submit information on income, property and property-related obligations, and the person holding that position shall submit information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure, to the Mayor of Moscow in the procedure established by Law of the City of Moscow No. 64 of 17 December 2014 “On Measures to Combat Corruption in the City of Moscow”.
moscow50-ud53c80e7919bf4c8fd-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-u8feab21840ffb9ef6e-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-ud3471c3a582fce4c63-1.text: 10. Verification of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations and information on expenditure submitted under Part 8 of this Article is carried out by decision of the Mayor of Moscow in the procedure established by the Law of the City of Moscow “On Measures to Combat Corruption in the City of Moscow”.
moscow50-ud3471c3a582fce4c63-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-ufd74d166ddd218eea0-1.text: 11. If verification under Part 10 of this Article reveals that the person holding the position of head of administration under contract has failed to comply with restrictions or prohibitions or to perform duties established by the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”, the Federal Law “On Monitoring the Correspondence of Expenditure of Persons Holding State Offices and Other Persons to Their Income”, or Federal Law No. 79-FZ of 7 May 2013 “On Prohibiting Certain Categories of Persons from Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, or Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments”, the Mayor of Moscow shall apply to the head of the municipal formation, the representative body or a court for early termination of the powers of the person holding the position of head of administration under contract or for another disciplinary sanction to be imposed on that person.
moscow50-ufd74d166ddd218eea0-1.locator: Article 17. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations, and information on expenditure

moscow50-u5350790fa105f8e01b-1.text: PERFORMANCE AND TERMINATION OF MUNICIPAL SERVICE

moscow50-u79546ada81ba7e6bbe-1.text: 1. Citizens who have reached the age of 18, have command of the state language of the Russian Federation and meet the qualification requirements established by this Law for municipal service positions are entitled to enter municipal service, provided that none of the circumstances specified as restrictions related to municipal service apply.

moscow50-u0bc1d5f8006a3919a3-1.text: 2. Upon entry into municipal service and during its performance, no direct or indirect restrictions or advantages may be established on grounds of sex, race, ethnicity, origin, property or official status, place of residence, attitude to religion, beliefs, membership in public associations, or other circumstances unrelated to a municipal servant’s professional and work-related qualities.

moscow50-u7455ee30c9539cd7fe-1.text: 3. Upon entry into municipal service, a citizen shall submit:

moscow50-ua05323edd3bc70038f-1.text: 1) an application requesting admission to municipal service and appointment to a municipal service position;

moscow50-ueec0dba391caa8d3e4-1.text: 2) the questionnaire provided for by Article 15.2 of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”;

moscow50-uec841cccce62e636aa-1.text: 4) the employment record book and/or information on employment history prepared in the procedure established by labour legislation, except where an employment agreement (contract) is concluded for the first time;

moscow50-u9ef14fdb5200c4720d-1.text: 5) a document on education and qualifications;

moscow50-u4b4edd60f469bd1c2b-1.text: 6) a document confirming registration in the individual (personalized) record-keeping system, except where an employment agreement (contract) is being concluded for the first time;

moscow50-ub688db023cdb6905a4-1.text: 7) a certificate of registration of the individual with the tax authority at the place of residence in the Russian Federation;

moscow50-u0680eb65d61d826263-1.text: 8) military registration documents — for persons liable for military service and persons subject to conscription;

moscow50-u9615e2f6e8e1bf2bea-1.text: 9) a medical organization’s conclusion confirming the absence of a disease preventing entry into municipal service;

moscow50-ucfc8479eb2c496b1e9-1.text: 10) information on income, property and property-related obligations;

moscow50-ue664c2c9be59c32420-1.text: 11) other documents provided for by federal legislation.

moscow50-uab82f798d6d7c54e54-1.text: 4. Information (except information contained in the questionnaire) submitted by a citizen entering municipal service under this Law may be verified in the procedure established by federal laws.

moscow50-ua4f220e5cf4b9f0882-1.text: 5. If verification under Part 4 of this Article establishes circumstances preventing a citizen from entering municipal service, that citizen shall be informed in writing of the reasons for refusal of entry into municipal service within three working days.

moscow50-u0559abf1a954b562e8-1.text: 6. A citizen enters municipal service through appointment to a municipal service position on the terms of an employment agreement in accordance with labour legislation, taking account of the specific features provided for by federal legislation and this Law. Appointment of a citizen to a municipal service position is formalised by an act of the employer’s representative (employer) appointing them to that position.

moscow50-ua057b5c05166bb97b3-1.text: 7. The parties to the employment contract upon entry into municipal service are the employer’s representative (employer) and the municipal servant.

moscow50-uc1bb792de543ace81a-1.text: 8. A contract is concluded with a citizen entering the position of head of administration following a competition to fill that position. The procedure for filling the position of head of administration under contract and the procedure for concluding and terminating a contract with a person appointed to that position under contract are determined by the Federal Law “On the General Principles of the Organisation of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation”, the Law of the City of Moscow “On the Organisation of Local Self-Government in the City of Moscow” and this Law.

moscow50-u028c0d4bb289cb2419-1.text: Article 19. Competition for a municipal service position
moscow50-u028c0d4bb289cb2419-1.locator: Article 19. Competition for a municipal service position

moscow50-u3484a568efdf98b1cb-1.text: 1. When filling a municipal service position in a municipal formation, conclusion of an employment agreement may be preceded by a competition (hereinafter, the competition), during which applicants’ professional level and their compliance with the qualification requirements established for the municipal service position are assessed.
moscow50-u3484a568efdf98b1cb-1.locator: Article 19. Competition for a municipal service position

moscow50-u8a2bcbb9aa02b7843d-1.text: 2. The cases and procedure for holding the competition are established by a municipal legal act of the representative body. The procedure must provide for publication of its conditions, information on the date, time and place, and the draft employment agreement at least 20 days before the competition. The representative body establishes the total membership of the competition commission in the municipal formation and the procedure for forming it.
moscow50-u8a2bcbb9aa02b7843d-1.locator: Article 19. Competition for a municipal service position

moscow50-u146fd99e85a0ad65a6-1.text: 3. A competition to fill the position of head of administration under contract is held in the procedure established by Article 20 of this Law.
moscow50-u146fd99e85a0ad65a6-1.locator: Article 19. Competition for a municipal service position

moscow50-uece3593267312fb06b-1.text: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract
moscow50-uece3593267312fb06b-1.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract

moscow50-uda8938e589a5e478ab-1.text: 1. The representative body establishes the procedure for holding a competition to fill the position of head of administration under contract.
