The procedure must provide for publication of the competition conditions, information on the date, time and place, and the draft contract at least 20 days before the competition.
moscow50-uda8938e589a5e478ab-1.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract

moscow50-uac0b015b2a63fccfbb-1.text: 2. The contract terms for the head of administration are established in accordance with Article 20.1 of this Law.
moscow50-uac0b015b2a63fccfbb-1.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract

moscow50-ue873746c23267a033d-1.text: 3. The representative body establishes the total membership of the competition commission in the municipal formation and the procedure for forming it.
moscow50-ue873746c23267a033d-1.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract

moscow50-u71d898185ec89270d8-1.text: 4. The representative body’s decision establishing the total membership of the competition commission in the municipal formation shall be sent to the Mayor of Moscow within two days of its adoption.
moscow50-u71d898185ec89270d8-1.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract

moscow50-uc89a1da9d1b080c4ca-1.text: 5. When the competition commission is formed, half its members are appointed by the representative body and the other half by the Mayor of Moscow.
moscow50-uc89a1da9d1b080c4ca-1.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract

moscow50-u0688d5796c7b2d5198-1.text: 6. The representative body appoints the head of administration from among candidates put forward by the competition commission on the basis of the competition results. Appointment shall take place within 30 days from the date on which the competition commission determines the results of the competition to fill the position of head of administration under contract.
moscow50-u0688d5796c7b2d5198-1.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract

moscow50-ueb75646ceea7f53d5b-1.text: 7. The contract with the head of administration is concluded by the head of the municipal formation. The standard form of contract with a person appointed under contract as head of administration of an intra-city municipal formation in the City of Moscow is approved by this Law (Appendix 1).
moscow50-ueb75646ceea7f53d5b-1.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract

moscow50-ua7e6208d31ac0b3888-1.text: 8. The contract with the head of administration is concluded for the term of office of the representative body that decided to appoint that person as head of administration (until the day the newly elected representative body begins its work), but for no less than two years.
moscow50-ua7e6208d31ac0b3888-1.locator: Article 20. Competition for the position of head of administration under a contract

moscow50-u8f63f0732486655fd0-1.text: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration
moscow50-u8f63f0732486655fd0-1.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration

moscow50-u6c409e10d9b6798f44-1.text: 1. The representative body approves the contract terms for the head of administration insofar as they concern the exercise of powers to resolve matters of local significance.
moscow50-u6c409e10d9b6798f44-1.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration

moscow50-u360459a241af7c3fa8-1.text: 2. When exercising individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, transferred powers), the head of administration shall:
moscow50-u360459a241af7c3fa8-1.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration

moscow50-uc3008961a02cef9aba-1.text: 1) organise and ensure the execution of transferred powers;
moscow50-uc3008961a02cef9aba-1.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration

moscow50-uc63fb5bdde98470e4f-1.text: 2) ensure the implementation of legal acts of the City of Moscow concerning transferred powers, including legal acts of authorised executive bodies of the City of Moscow exercising state supervision over local self-government bodies’ exercise of transferred powers;
moscow50-uc63fb5bdde98470e4f-1.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration

moscow50-uc3dab2ae07fdb861fa-1.text: 3) submit (ensure the submission of), in the prescribed procedure, to authorised executive bodies of the City of Moscow calculations of the financial costs required to exercise transferred powers, reports on their execution, including the use of financial resources, and other documents and information related to the exercise of transferred powers;
moscow50-uc3dab2ae07fdb861fa-1.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration

moscow50-u273cb4fa6edc33ae29-1.text: 4) ensure the designated use and proper maintenance of material resources and the designated use of financial resources provided to local self-government bodies for the exercise of transferred powers;
moscow50-u273cb4fa6edc33ae29-1.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration

moscow50-u66e8a4ef449fb642ce-1.text: 5) ensure the return to the budget of the City of Moscow of interbudgetary transfers received as subventions and not used in the current financial year;
moscow50-u66e8a4ef449fb642ce-1.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration

moscow50-uff574275ec6fd9166e-1.text: 6) be entitled to request and receive from state authorities of the City of Moscow information concerning the performance of transferred powers, including explanations and recommendations on their exercise;
moscow50-uff574275ec6fd9166e-1.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration

moscow50-ubda008b74386a18845-1.text: 7) ensure conditions for state supervisory bodies to supervise the administration’s execution of transferred powers as regards the designated expenditure of financial resources, and to conduct legal examination and analysis of the administration’s legal acts adopted on matters concerning transferred powers, in the forms provided for by legal acts of the City of Moscow;
moscow50-ubda008b74386a18845-1.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration

moscow50-ua7f4ff9e65990e37a1-1.text: 8) within their powers, issue administration resolutions on matters concerning the exercise of transferred powers;
moscow50-ua7f4ff9e65990e37a1-1.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration

moscow50-ub4f748f5b985c0bba9-1.text: 9) exercise other powers established by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-ub4f748f5b985c0bba9-1.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration

moscow50-u4f50676dc31e6ff215-1.text: 3. The provisions of Part 2 of this Article constitute the contract terms for the head of administration insofar as they concern the exercise of transferred powers.
moscow50-u4f50676dc31e6ff215-1.locator: Article 20.1. Contract terms for the head of administration

moscow50-u7c179e8ecf4a4fdb03-1.text: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service
moscow50-u7c179e8ecf4a4fdb03-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-ub1cae643a258275b6f-1.text: 1. When an employment agreement is concluded with a citizen entering municipal service, the parties may agree to include a probation condition to verify the employee’s suitability for the municipal service position held. The probation period may not exceed three months. For the deputy head of administration, chief accountant, head of a department and head of a sector, the probation period may not exceed six months; for persons concluding an employment agreement for a term of two to six months, it may not exceed two weeks.
moscow50-ub1cae643a258275b6f-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-u085869fcd41599d6c5-1.text: 2. Absence of a probation condition in the employment agreement means that the municipal servant has been admitted to municipal service without probation.
moscow50-u085869fcd41599d6c5-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-u3fe200a8b9d1bdeb43-1.text: 3. During probation, the municipal servant is subject to labour legislation, taking account of the specific features provided for by federal law and this Law.
moscow50-u3fe200a8b9d1bdeb43-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-u7f8672fb98d5702c8b-1.text: 4. No probation upon entry into municipal service is established for:
moscow50-u7f8672fb98d5702c8b-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-u3963a51e6af0f2fc8d-1.text: 1) persons selected by competition to fill the relevant municipal service position;
moscow50-u3963a51e6af0f2fc8d-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-u862ecc9db078a86fea-1.text: 2) pregnant women and women with children under one and a half years of age;
moscow50-u862ecc9db078a86fea-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-u34f50197dd7c1a4246-1.text: 3) persons who have obtained secondary vocational or higher education through state-accredited educational programmes and enter municipal service for the first time in their acquired speciality within one year of obtaining vocational or higher education at the relevant level;
moscow50-u34f50197dd7c1a4246-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-u21128977cf12dcc398-1.text: 4) municipal servants invited to work by transfer from another local self-government body, and municipal servants appointed to municipal service positions by transfer in connection with the liquidation or reorganisation of another local self-government body or the reduction of municipal service positions;
moscow50-u21128977cf12dcc398-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-uc1b2bc5ebccf0699f0-1.text: 5) persons concluding an employment agreement for a term of up to two months;
moscow50-uc1b2bc5ebccf0699f0-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-u5153c71cf2e3d1b191-1.text: 6) other persons in cases provided for by federal laws.
moscow50-u5153c71cf2e3d1b191-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-u34495a2c2ba46d6c64-1.text: 5. Periods of temporary incapacity for work and other periods when the municipal servant was absent from municipal service are not included in the probation period.
moscow50-u34495a2c2ba46d6c64-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-u3a63e40dec46ed09e6-1.text: 6. If probation results are unsatisfactory, the employer’s representative (employer) may terminate the employment agreement with the municipal servant before the probation period expires, giving written notice at least three days in advance and stating the reasons for finding that the municipal servant has failed probation. The municipal servant may challenge the decision to terminate the employment agreement in court.
moscow50-u3a63e40dec46ed09e6-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-u09821ac269735abc87-1.text: 7. Before the probation period expires, the employment agreement may be terminated on the municipal servant’s initiative; the servant must give the employer’s representative (employer) written notice at least three days in advance.
moscow50-u09821ac269735abc87-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-u0d5c7d1017fbe2be78-1.text: 8. If the probation period has expired and the municipal servant continues to hold the municipal service position, the servant is deemed to have passed probation.
moscow50-u0d5c7d1017fbe2be78-1.locator: Article 21. Probation on entry into municipal service

moscow50-uee1406c5039bb3d059-1.text: 1. Assessment of a municipal servant (hereinafter, assessment) is conducted by an assessment commission to determine the servant’s suitability for the municipal service position held. Assessment is conducted once every three years.

moscow50-u7f63469ab95626c67a-1.text: 2. The following municipal servants are not subject to appraisal:

moscow50-u006aad4e365869ec8a-1.text: 1) those who have held municipal service positions for less than one year;

moscow50-u0c0705c959c3d7f056-1.text: 2) those who have reached the age of 60;

moscow50-udbd38c668a0a2626c9-1.text: 3) those on maternity leave or on leave to care for a child until the child reaches the age of three. Such municipal servants may be appraised no earlier than one year after returning from leave;

moscow50-ue2675f06d235863333-1.text: 5) those with whom a fixed-term employment agreement (contract) has been concluded;

moscow50-u0da1f2a968bce7887b-1.text: 6) those within one year after being awarded a class rank.

moscow50-uf17015632c4a56512e-1.text: 3. Following assessment, the assessment commission decides whether or not the municipal servant is suitable for the municipal service position held. It may recommend rewards, including promotion, for individual municipal servants’ achievements at work and, where necessary, measures to improve the work of the servants assessed. It may also recommend that individual municipal servants be sent for additional professional education. Assessment results are communicated to the servants assessed immediately after the voting results are finalised. Assessment materials are forwarded to the employer’s representative (employer).

moscow50-ubcd7a8c82bf3379b82-1.text: 4. Following assessment, the employer’s representative (employer) decides on rewards for individual municipal servants’ achievements at work, or, within no more than one month from the assessment date, on demoting a municipal servant with their consent.

moscow50-u5c8502792b0d1523b3-1.text: 5. If a municipal servant does not consent to demotion or cannot be transferred with their consent to another municipal service position, the employer’s representative (employer) may, within no more than one month from the appraisal, dismiss the servant from municipal service for being unsuited to the position held due to insufficient qualifications confirmed by the appraisal results. After that period expires, dismissal or demotion of the municipal servant on the basis of that appraisal is not permitted.

moscow50-u40076f39068b868ac7-1.text: 6. A municipal servant is entitled to challenge the appraisal results in court.

moscow50-u25edfe0c83918ad3f1-1.text: 7. The regulations on assessment are approved by a municipal legal act in accordance with the Standard Regulations on Assessment of Municipal Servants of Local Self-Government Bodies of Intra-City Municipal Formations in the City of Moscow, approved by this Law (Appendix 2).

moscow50-u2cddf3956faa12b2c8-1.text: 8. The assessment result is entered in the municipal servant’s assessment sheet drawn up in the form set out in Appendix 3 to this Law. The assessment sheet is signed by the chair, deputy chair, secretary and members of the assessment commission present at the meeting. The municipal servant acknowledges the assessment sheet by signing it.

moscow50-u6b618ab66d21aa1f92-1.text: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant
moscow50-u6b618ab66d21aa1f92-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-u1e552606f374289c73-1.text: 1. A qualification examination of a municipal servant (hereinafter, the qualification examination) is held for a citizen entering municipal service for the first time, for a municipal servant appointed to a higher municipal service position in another group of positions, or on a municipal servant’s initiative, to determine their professional training level, compliance with the requirements for professional knowledge and skills needed to perform official duties, and to decide on awarding a class rank. A qualification examination on a municipal servant’s initiative is held on the basis of their personal written application.
moscow50-u1e552606f374289c73-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-ua8d174238153ee65d0-1.text: 2. A citizen entering municipal service for the first time takes the qualification examination no earlier than three months after appointment if no probation period was established, or no later than one month after the probation period ends. Such a citizen is awarded the minimum class rank for the group of municipal service positions to which their position belongs. A municipal servant appointed to a higher municipal service position takes the qualification examination no earlier than six months after appointment to that position.
moscow50-ua8d174238153ee65d0-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-u8b68cfb496e9d4d6eb-1.text: 3. The qualification examination is held no more than once a year.
moscow50-u8b68cfb496e9d4d6eb-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-u321ae24711296e45e6-1.text: 4. The assessment commission conducts the qualification examination.
moscow50-u321ae24711296e45e6-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-u2ac7549724937913e8-1.text: 5. The qualification examination is held on the basis of a legal act of the employer’s representative (employer), specifying its place, date, time and grounds, the date for submitting the necessary documents to the assessment commission, and the persons responsible for preparing them.
moscow50-u2ac7549724937913e8-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-u77e7ba25ea939e6ab8-1.text: 6. Within three working days after the employer’s representative (employer) issues the legal act on holding the qualification examination, the assessment commission communicates it to the municipal servant against signature.
moscow50-u77e7ba25ea939e6ab8-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-u9e41a6665980dc4277-1.text: 7. A report on the municipal servant’s level of knowledge and skills (professional level), signed by the head of the structural unit where the servant works, shall be submitted to the assessment commission at least two weeks before the qualification examination.
moscow50-u9e41a6665980dc4277-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-u58378f92848352d061-1.text: 8. At least one week before the qualification examination, the assessment commission familiarises the municipal servant with the report. The servant may submit additional information on their professional activity in the preceding period and, if they disagree with the report, a statement to that effect.
moscow50-u58378f92848352d061-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-u84815f17a6fc499591-1.text: 9. In conducting the qualification examination, the assessment commission evaluates municipal servants’ knowledge and skills (professional level) in accordance with the complexity and responsibility of their work, through examination procedures using methods of assessing their professional qualities that do not conflict with federal laws or other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation, including individual interviews and testing on matters connected with official duties in the municipal service position held.
moscow50-u84815f17a6fc499591-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-ua8e130715302ee799e-1.text: 10. The assessment commission decides the qualification examination result in the absence of the municipal servant and their immediate supervisor, by open vote and a simple majority of commission members present at the meeting. If votes are equal, the municipal servant is deemed to have passed.
moscow50-ua8e130715302ee799e-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-u3da5fcd600bd6d7d58-1.text: 11. Following the qualification examination, the assessment commission adopts one of the following decisions:
moscow50-u3da5fcd600bd6d7d58-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-ub8e5b22bef2fcca37b-1.text: 1) the qualification examination has been passed and the municipal servant is recommended for the award of a class rank;
moscow50-ub8e5b22bef2fcca37b-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-u9717b3884302a58464-1.text: 2) the qualification examination has not been passed.
moscow50-u9717b3884302a58464-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-u11d1393c1b7839a869-1.text: 12. The qualification examination result is entered in the municipal servant’s examination sheet drawn up in the form set out in Appendix 4 to this Law. The examination sheet is signed by the chair, deputy chair, secretary and members of the assessment commission present at the meeting. The municipal servant acknowledges the examination sheet by signing it.
moscow50-u11d1393c1b7839a869-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-u6e3e5c07ac06c937b2-1.text: 13. The qualification examination results shall be sent to the employer’s representative (employer) no later than seven days after the examination.
moscow50-u6e3e5c07ac06c937b2-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-u228b66b603a72b13a4-1.text: 14. On the basis of the qualification examination results, the employer’s representative (employer) decides on awarding a class rank to the municipal servant in the prescribed procedure.
moscow50-u228b66b603a72b13a4-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-ucae91857fb47d77dd6-1.text: 15. A municipal servant who has not passed the qualification examination may request a repeat examination no earlier than six months after that examination.
moscow50-ucae91857fb47d77dd6-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-ua043d7e0f7c9cb5fd2-1.text: 16. A municipal servant may challenge the qualification examination results in court.
moscow50-ua043d7e0f7c9cb5fd2-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-ue099235325b08e0111-1.text: 17. The municipal servant’s examination sheet, the report on their level of knowledge and skills (professional level) and on the possibility of awarding them a class rank, additional information submitted by the servant for the preceding period, and any statement disagreeing with the report are kept in the servant’s personal file.
moscow50-ue099235325b08e0111-1.locator: Article 23. Qualification examination of a municipal servant

moscow50-ue5ff50546223eeecc2-1.text: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank
moscow50-ue5ff50546223eeecc2-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-u1e86cf48544b22aaf9-1.text: 1. A class rank indicates a municipal servant’s professional training level in relation to official duties in the position held and is the basis for establishing the corresponding supplement to their official salary.
moscow50-u1e86cf48544b22aaf9-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-ufa992b15bb2fe56ed4-1.text: 2. Municipal servants are awarded the following class ranks:
moscow50-ufa992b15bb2fe56ed4-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-u498edd0bba718532fd-1.text: 1) actual municipal counsellor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class — to municipal servants holding highest municipal service positions;
moscow50-u498edd0bba718532fd-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-ub5b0281b156eb9823a-1.text: 2) municipal counsellor of the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class — to municipal servants holding principal municipal service positions;
moscow50-ub5b0281b156eb9823a-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-u4a7d2c6a5747cff7ac-1.text: 3) municipal service counsellor in the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class — to municipal servants holding leading municipal service positions;
moscow50-u4a7d2c6a5747cff7ac-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-ud9bd21740966931488-1.text: 4) municipal service referent in the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class — to municipal servants holding senior municipal service positions;
moscow50-ud9bd21740966931488-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-u047dfbd01f32f70eb8-1.text: 5) municipal service secretary in the City of Moscow, 1st, 2nd or 3rd class — to municipal servants holding junior municipal service positions.
moscow50-u047dfbd01f32f70eb8-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-uefa527a09fae3d86d9-1.text: 3. A citizen holding a municipal service position under a fixed-term employment agreement is awarded a class rank without taking a qualification examination no later than six months after appointment.
moscow50-uefa527a09fae3d86d9-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-uf6824343fec6d3e0c1-1.text: 4. Citizens who previously served in state service, hold class ranks, diplomatic ranks, military ranks or special ranks, and enter municipal service may be awarded a class rank above the minimum for the relevant group of municipal service positions.
moscow50-uf6824343fec6d3e0c1-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-u5d86e67a22f8aa6e52-1.text: 5. A citizen holding a state civil service class rank who enters municipal service is awarded a municipal servant’s class rank on their initiative, based on qualification examination results or without an examination, in accordance with the table of correspondence between state civil service class ranks and municipal servants’ class ranks, from the date of appointment to a municipal service position:
moscow50-u5d86e67a22f8aa6e52-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-u670999ec1c7cd75c12-1.text: actual state counsellor of the City of Moscow, 1st class | actual municipal counsellor of the City of Moscow, 1st class actual state counsellor of the City of Moscow, 2nd class | actual municipal counsellor of the City of Moscow, 2nd class actual state counsellor of the City of Moscow, 3rd class | actual municipal counsellor of the City of Moscow, 3rd class state counsellor of the City of Moscow, 1st class | municipal counsellor of the City of Moscow, 1st class state counsellor of the City of Moscow, 2nd class | municipal counsellor of the City of Moscow, 2nd class state counsellor of the City of Moscow, 3rd class | municipal counsellor of the City of Moscow, 3rd class state civil service counsellor of the City of Moscow, 1st class | municipal service counsellor in the City of Moscow, 1st class state civil service counsellor of the City of Moscow, 2nd class | municipal service counsellor in the City of Moscow, 2nd class state civil service counsellor of the City of Moscow, 3rd class | municipal service counsellor in the City of Moscow, 3rd class state civil service referent of the City of Moscow, 1st class | municipal service referent in the City of Moscow, 1st class state civil service referent of the City of Moscow, 2nd class | municipal service referent in the City of Moscow, 2nd class state civil service referent of the City of Moscow, 3rd class | municipal service referent in the City of Moscow, 3rd class state civil service secretary of the City of Moscow, 1st class | municipal service secretary in the City of Moscow, 1st class state civil service secretary of the City of Moscow, 2nd class | municipal service secretary in the City of Moscow, 2nd class state civil service secretary of the City of Moscow, 3rd class | municipal service secretary in the City of Moscow, 3rd class
moscow50-u670999ec1c7cd75c12-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-uc1c15cebf654baf3ad-1.text: 6. A municipal servant may be awarded the next class rank no earlier than one year after being awarded the previous class rank.
moscow50-uc1c15cebf654baf3ad-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-uf97c491e34fdb8dd40-1.text: 7. A municipal servant may be awarded the next class rank before one year has elapsed since the previous award if appointed to a higher municipal service position within the same group of positions, but no earlier than six months after appointment.
moscow50-uf97c491e34fdb8dd40-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-ud6efff85e4994f231d-1.text: 8. When a municipal servant is appointed to a higher municipal service position in another group of positions, they may be awarded, out of sequence, the minimum class rank for the relevant group, but no earlier than six months after appointment.
moscow50-ud6efff85e4994f231d-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-u5795e00319a1a32644-1.text: 9. The representative body awards a class rank to a municipal servant holding the position of head of administration under contract.
moscow50-u5795e00319a1a32644-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-uf7aa90ca14f8ebe143-1.text: 10. Except in the case provided for by Part 9 of this Article, the employer’s representative (employer) awards a class rank to a municipal servant.
moscow50-uf7aa90ca14f8ebe143-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-u4ac0e5f14a56112198-1.text: 11. Information on the class rank awarded to a municipal servant is entered in their employment record book (if any).
moscow50-u4ac0e5f14a56112198-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-ubb5c789822d863ba78-1.text: 12. A municipal servant may be deprived of an awarded class rank by a court sentence. The employer’s representative’s (employer’s) legal act awarding a class rank may be revoked by a corresponding legal act of the employer’s representative (employer) if the servant submitted forged documents or knowingly false information on the basis of which the rank was awarded, or if the procedure for awarding class ranks established by this Law was violated.
moscow50-ubb5c789822d863ba78-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-u186ef858a4b0041e5a-1.text: 13. The official salary supplement for a class rank is paid from the date on which the corresponding rank is awarded to the municipal servant.
moscow50-u186ef858a4b0041e5a-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-u10fa9ee54345f61fb2-1.text: 14. A class rank awarded to a municipal servant is retained upon termination of municipal service.
moscow50-u10fa9ee54345f61fb2-1.locator: Article 24. Procedure for awarding and retaining a class rank

moscow50-u335e86a0b7dca09eeb-1.text: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service
moscow50-u335e86a0b7dca09eeb-1.locator: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service

moscow50-u209eea7fb1cfd0c0fa-1.text: 1. An individual labour dispute in municipal service (hereinafter, an individual labour dispute) means unresolved disagreements between the employer’s representative (employer) and a municipal servant or a citizen entering or formerly in municipal service concerning the application of federal legislation and normative legal acts of the City of Moscow on municipal service and the employment agreement (contract), which have been referred to a body considering individual labour disputes.
moscow50-u209eea7fb1cfd0c0fa-1.locator: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service

moscow50-u4f927221dd4bbf51ca-1.text: 2. Labour dispute commissions and courts are the bodies that consider individual labour disputes.
moscow50-u4f927221dd4bbf51ca-1.locator: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service

moscow50-u0a863d545484068d83-1.text: 3. A labour dispute commission is formed on the initiative of municipal servants and/or the employer’s representative (employer), with equal numbers of representatives of the municipal servants and of the employer’s representative (employer).
moscow50-u0a863d545484068d83-1.locator: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service

moscow50-u18fb0eed01f2ad5978-1.text: 4. The head of the local self-government body appoints the employer’s (employer’s representative’s) representatives to the labour dispute commission. Municipal servants’ representatives are elected to the commission in accordance with the procedure established by labour legislation.
moscow50-u18fb0eed01f2ad5978-1.locator: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service

moscow50-u08e816d3c7659b89d1-1.text: 5. The employer’s representative (employer) approves the regulations on the labour dispute commission.
moscow50-u08e816d3c7659b89d1-1.locator: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service

moscow50-ua758537e521c680aab-1.text: 6. An individual labour dispute is considered in the procedure established by federal legislation.
moscow50-ua758537e521c680aab-1.locator: Article 25. Individual labour disputes in municipal service

moscow50-ua803f17667838251be-1.text: Article 26. Termination of an employment contract with a municipal servant
moscow50-ua803f17667838251be-1.locator: Article 26. Termination of an employment contract with a municipal servant

moscow50-u19af1ab6d262ecfa42-1.text: 1. Municipal service terminates on the date the employment agreement (contract) is terminated and the municipal servant is dismissed from the municipal service position.
moscow50-u19af1ab6d262ecfa42-1.locator: Article 26. Termination of an employment contract with a municipal servant

moscow50-ub3562b3de571a9d3a4-1.text: 2. The employment agreement with a municipal servant is terminated if they fail to comply with restrictions and prohibitions related to municipal service provided for by the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation” and this Law, and also in the procedure and on the grounds provided for by labour legislation and other federal laws.
moscow50-ub3562b3de571a9d3a4-1.locator: Article 26. Termination of an employment contract with a municipal servant

moscow50-ubc632fe3c62ccbcdd4-1.text: 3. The powers of the head of administration exercised under contract terminate early in the cases established by the Federal Law “On the General Principles of the Organisation of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation”.
moscow50-ubc632fe3c62ccbcdd4-1.locator: Article 26. Termination of an employment contract with a municipal servant

moscow50-udbe751d308c657c155-1.text: 4. Repealed. — Law of the City of Moscow of 21.12.2011 No. 68.
moscow50-udbe751d308c657c155-1.locator: Article 26. Termination of an employment contract with a municipal servant

moscow50-ub7f33f397360371e09-1.text: Chapter 5. WORKING (OFFICIAL DUTY) TIME AND REST TIME
moscow50-ub7f33f397360371e09-1.locator: Chapter 5. WORKING (OFFICIAL DUTY) TIME AND REST TIME

moscow50-u624456a4ee43b20a31-1.text: 1. Working (service) time means the time during which a municipal servant must perform official duties in accordance with the local self-government body’s service rules, service schedule and terms of the employment agreement (contract), as well as other periods classified as service time by federal laws and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.

moscow50-u309124933674f3abb0-1.text: 2. A municipal servant’s normal working (service) time may not exceed 40 hours per week. A five-day working (service) week is established for municipal servants.

moscow50-u0a22e9618964171a41-1.text: 3. The list of municipal servants’ positions with irregular working hours is established by a municipal legal act of the representative body.

moscow50-u462d58d8fff82ab7a5-1.text: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant
moscow50-u462d58d8fff82ab7a5-1.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant

moscow50-ubc1144e48240737f48-1.text: 1. A municipal servant is granted annual paid leave with retention of the municipal service position held and remuneration, the amount of which is determined in the procedure established by labour legislation for calculating average wages.
moscow50-ubc1144e48240737f48-1.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant

moscow50-u870ff360c264088229-1.text: 2. A municipal servant’s annual paid leave consists of basic paid leave and additional paid leave. Annual basic paid leave and annual additional paid leave are added together.
moscow50-u870ff360c264088229-1.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant

moscow50-u75fb69aa5d6ec01c08-1.text: 3. Municipal servants are granted annual basic paid leave of 30 calendar days.
moscow50-u75fb69aa5d6ec01c08-1.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant

moscow50-ufec654769d75f5dd74-1.text: 4. Annual additional paid leave is granted to a municipal servant for length of service (no more than 10 calendar days) and in the cases provided for by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-ufec654769d75f5dd74-1.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant

moscow50-u2986d78eede639dd55-1.text: 5. Annual additional paid leave for length of service is calculated at one calendar day for each year of municipal service.
moscow50-u2986d78eede639dd55-1.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant

moscow50-u3591668574516e5507-1.text: 5.1. A municipal servant subject to an irregular working day is granted additional annual paid leave of three calendar days for that working arrangement.
moscow50-u3591668574516e5507-1.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant

moscow50-u26696a633ed3eb7032-1.text: 6. At a municipal servant’s request, annual paid leave may be granted in parts. One part of the leave granted must be no shorter than 14 calendar days.
moscow50-u26696a633ed3eb7032-1.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant

moscow50-u6e1a2e9e3538fd81c6-1.text: 7. On a municipal servant’s written application, the employer’s representative (employer) may decide to grant unpaid leave of no more than one year. Unpaid leave is also granted in the cases provided for by federal laws.
moscow50-u6e1a2e9e3538fd81c6-1.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant

moscow50-u85c783ddaa7be1eca7-1.text: 8. Failure to grant a municipal servant annual paid leave for two consecutive years is prohibited.
moscow50-u85c783ddaa7be1eca7-1.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant

moscow50-uf9639b89739742ba27-1.text: 9. Remuneration for a municipal servant’s annual paid leave must be paid at least 10 calendar days before the leave begins.
moscow50-uf9639b89739742ba27-1.locator: Article 28. Leave of a municipal servant

moscow50-ufd82547933c1216eb4-1.text: Chapter 6. REMUNERATION OF A MUNICIPAL SERVANT.
moscow50-ufd82547933c1216eb4-1.locator: Chapter 6. REMUNERATION OF A MUNICIPAL SERVANT.

moscow50-u9d67f7e78b25ff15ab-1.locator: Chapter 6. REMUNERATION OF A MUNICIPAL SERVANT.

moscow50-u227dd9926b3bfff152-1.locator: Chapter 6. REMUNERATION OF A MUNICIPAL SERVANT.

moscow50-u441b1b3214b527585d-1.text: Article 29. Monetary remuneration of a municipal servant
moscow50-u441b1b3214b527585d-1.locator: Article 29. Monetary remuneration of a municipal servant

moscow50-u8bcd9687c1e35942fc-1.text: 1. Local self-government bodies independently determine the amounts and terms of municipal servants’ pay. The official salary amount, amounts of monthly and other additional payments and the procedure for making them are established by municipal legal acts in accordance with federal legislation and laws of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-u8bcd9687c1e35942fc-1.locator: Article 29. Monetary remuneration of a municipal servant

moscow50-u9dfac30c673e64060d-1.text: 2. A municipal servant is paid in the form of remuneration comprising an official salary corresponding to the municipal service position held (hereinafter, official salary), monthly monetary incentives, official salary supplements for class rank, length of service and special municipal service conditions, a lump-sum payment for regular annual paid leave, material assistance, and bonuses for performing especially important and complex assignments.
moscow50-u9dfac30c673e64060d-1.locator: Article 29. Monetary remuneration of a municipal servant

moscow50-u52aad7358d8e9aebb6-2.text: 3. Repealed. — Law of the City of Moscow of 16.09.2009 No. 34.
moscow50-u52aad7358d8e9aebb6-2.locator: Article 29. Monetary remuneration of a municipal servant

moscow50-ub87b2ac6bc134a3503-1.text: 4. Budget appropriations for municipal servants’ pay in municipal formations are planned according to payroll fund formation standards established for state civil servants by normative legal acts of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-ub87b2ac6bc134a3503-1.locator: Article 29. Monetary remuneration of a municipal servant

moscow50-u9ca3a8413011c8c0e7-1.text: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation
moscow50-u9ca3a8413011c8c0e7-1.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation

moscow50-u4dc07bd66ac05346c9-1.text: 1. In accordance with federal legislation, a municipal servant is guaranteed:
moscow50-u4dc07bd66ac05346c9-1.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation

moscow50-uf760b89e541e42a455-1.text: 1) working conditions that enable performance of official duties in accordance with the job description;
moscow50-uf760b89e541e42a455-1.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation

moscow50-uf23cbe807afbc8d08f-1.text: 2) the right to receive monetary remuneration on time and in full;
moscow50-uf23cbe807afbc8d08f-1.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation

moscow50-ud812a7e107e4c3753b-1.text: 3) rest, ensured through standard working (service) hours, days off and non-working public holidays, and annual paid leave;
moscow50-ud812a7e107e4c3753b-1.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation

moscow50-u07990b67bd3dc42abb-1.text: 4) medical care for the municipal servant and members of the servant’s family, including after the servant retires;
moscow50-u07990b67bd3dc42abb-1.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation

moscow50-u8eb6b3a8dd25823510-1.text: 5) pensions for length of service and disability, and pensions for family members if the municipal servant dies in connection with the performance of official duties, in the procedure and on the terms established by federal law;
moscow50-u8eb6b3a8dd25823510-1.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation

moscow50-ue66e6c2af20916ee26-1.text: 6) compulsory state insurance against harm to the municipal servant’s life, health or property in connection with the performance of official duties;
moscow50-ue66e6c2af20916ee26-1.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation

moscow50-ucad262f823dab17bea-1.text: 7) compulsory state social insurance against illness or incapacity for work arising during municipal service or after its termination, but in connection with the performance of official duties;
moscow50-ucad262f823dab17bea-1.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation

moscow50-uc06a63801a1ab8e133-1.text: 8) protection of the municipal servant, including their family members, against violence, threats and other unlawful actions in connection with the performance of official duties, in the cases, procedure and on the terms established by federal law.
moscow50-uc06a63801a1ab8e133-1.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation

moscow50-ucdf61082cd7e6f3433-1.text: 2. When an employment agreement with a municipal servant is terminated because a local self-government body is liquidated or its staff is reduced, the servant is provided with the guarantees established by federal legislation for employees dismissed because an organisation is liquidated or its staff is reduced.
moscow50-ucdf61082cd7e6f3433-1.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation

moscow50-u8468cb7054f46305b7-1.text: 3. The municipal servant’s family members referred to in Points 4, 5 and 8 of Part 1 of this Article mean the spouse, minor children, children over 18 who became disabled before reaching 18, and children under 23 studying full-time in basic educational programmes at organisations engaged in educational activities.
moscow50-u8468cb7054f46305b7-1.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation

moscow50-uaf09350f45aa4e0dee-1.text: 4. The representative body determines the procedure for providing a municipal servant with the basic state guarantees established by this Article.
moscow50-uaf09350f45aa4e0dee-1.locator: Article 30. Basic state guarantees provided to a municipal servant under federal legislation

moscow50-u97b5e13ec1b52c0cd1-1.text: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow
moscow50-u97b5e13ec1b52c0cd1-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-u067e2f00000cd445a0-1.text: 1. In addition to basic state guarantees established by federal legislation, a municipal servant is provided with additional guarantees in accordance with this Law, other laws of the City of Moscow and the charters of municipal formations.
moscow50-u067e2f00000cd445a0-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-u65758339b52d3341ca-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-u6de57a66086317e103-1.text: 1) additional monetary payments provided for by legislation of the City of Moscow;
moscow50-u6de57a66086317e103-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-u26eaf3c7dfd2dc15d6-1.text: 2) a free or subsidised health-resort voucher for annual paid leave, with payment of travel to and from the holiday destination, or corresponding compensation;
moscow50-u26eaf3c7dfd2dc15d6-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-udcfd59e895340f02ba-1.text: 3) additional professional education with retention of remuneration during training;
moscow50-udcfd59e895340f02ba-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-ud7caa74c1f0b683e22-1.text: 4) a monthly pension supplement to an old-age insurance pension or a disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability, awarded in accordance with Federal Law No. 400-FZ of 28 December 2013 “On Insurance Pensions” or awarded early in accordance with Law of the Russian Federation No. 1032-1 of 19 April 1991 “On Employment of the Population in the Russian Federation” (hereinafter, the pension supplement). The pension supplement is established where the person has a length of municipal service whose minimum duration for the relevant year is determined under Appendix 2 to Federal Law No. 166-FZ of 15 December 2001 “On State Pension Provision in the Russian Federation”. The supplement is set so that the total old-age insurance pension or disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability and the supplement equals 55 percent of the municipal servant’s monthly remuneration in the last municipal service position held before reaching the age specified in Appendix 5 to the Federal Law “On Insurance Pensions”, or before dismissal from municipal service. The supplement increases by three percent of the municipal servant’s monthly remuneration for every full year of service exceeding the minimum municipal service duration prescribed by federal legislation for the relevant year; the total old-age insurance pension or disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability and the supplement may not exceed 80 percent of the monthly remuneration taken into account when calculating the supplement. The conditions for awarding the supplement and the monthly remuneration used in its calculation are determined in the procedure established for state civil servants of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, state civil servants). The supplement is recalculated when the official salary for the corresponding municipal service position is increased centrally or the amount of the old-age insurance pension or disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability changes;
moscow50-ud7caa74c1f0b683e22-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-u25d8283befb6a666ee-1.text: 5) a lump-sum monetary incentive upon reaching 50 years of age and every five years thereafter, in amounts not exceeding two months’ remuneration for the municipal service position held;
moscow50-u25d8283befb6a666ee-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-u70725a4cce3ac7e975-1.text: 6) a lump-sum monetary incentive upon reaching 20 years of municipal service and every five years thereafter, in amounts not exceeding two months’ remuneration for the position held, provided that the servant has at least five years of municipal service in local self-government bodies in the City of Moscow;
moscow50-u70725a4cce3ac7e975-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-udcd20b2722c7b2957d-1.text: 7) a monetary award paid once over the entire period of municipal service on removal from the position held and dismissal where the servant is entitled to an old-age insurance pension or a disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability. The amount is calculated using the average monthly wage in the last municipal service position held before service terminated, multiplied by the number of full years of municipal service, but for no more than 10 years as of the date of termination. No payment is made to a municipal servant who previously received an analogous payment on leaving state civil service of the City of Moscow. A servant who previously received an analogous payment on leaving federal military service, federal law enforcement service, state civil service, state civil service in other constituent entities of the Russian Federation or municipal service in other constituent entities is paid in proportion to the number of full years respectively of state civil service in state bodies of the City of Moscow and municipal service in the City of Moscow in local self-government bodies and municipal bodies.
moscow50-udcd20b2722c7b2957d-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-uab8f6188ab513ba75d-1.text: 3. The maximum total of a municipal servant’s old-age insurance pension or disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability and pension supplement may not exceed the maximum total of an old-age insurance pension or a disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability and the pension supplement for a state civil servant in the corresponding state civil service position.
moscow50-uab8f6188ab513ba75d-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-ub79fb7fa6b445da547-1.text: 4. Guarantees for a municipal servant established by Points 4 and 6 of Part 1 of Article 30 and Points 2 and 4 of Part 2 of this Article are provided to an extent not exceeding the corresponding guarantees for state civil servants holding positions in the corresponding groups of state civil service positions.
moscow50-ub79fb7fa6b445da547-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-u18cb3fcbf4896f2735-1.text: 5. A municipal servant who retires from municipal service on an old-age insurance pension or a disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disability and is entitled to a pension supplement under Point 4 of Part 2 of this Article retains the guarantees provided for by Point 2 of Part 2 of this Article, to an extent not exceeding the corresponding guarantee for state civil servants.
moscow50-u18cb3fcbf4896f2735-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-u9a7cc5051b0322d6f3-1.text: 6. The municipal servant’s family members or other persons who arranged the funeral are reimbursed funeral service expenses in the procedure and on the terms established for state civil servants.
moscow50-u9a7cc5051b0322d6f3-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-u62a7d15e9e7916abce-1.text: 7. The representative body determines the procedure for providing a municipal servant with the guarantees established by this Article.
moscow50-u62a7d15e9e7916abce-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-uabcfb33f9eee2f1bc2-1.text: 8. Expenses associated with providing a municipal servant and their family members with the guarantees provided for by this Article are paid from the local budget.
moscow50-uabcfb33f9eee2f1bc2-1.locator: Article 31. Additional guarantees provided to a municipal servant under the legislation of the City of Moscow

moscow50-u5cf31952b4ed4767d0-1.text: Article 32. Pension provision for a municipal servant and members of their family
moscow50-u5cf31952b4ed4767d0-1.locator: Article 32. Pension provision for a municipal servant and members of their family

moscow50-ub05c347944b5a98555-1.text: 1. In pension provision, a municipal servant enjoys in full the rights of a state civil servant established by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-ub05c347944b5a98555-1.locator: Article 32. Pension provision for a municipal servant and members of their family

moscow50-u355d05cbd6b4e1e16d-1.text: 2. A municipal servant’s state pension amount is determined in accordance with the correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions established by this Law. The maximum municipal servant’s state pension may not exceed the maximum state pension for a state civil servant in the corresponding state civil service position.
moscow50-u355d05cbd6b4e1e16d-1.locator: Article 32. Pension provision for a municipal servant and members of their family

moscow50-u2bc5b78a0dac9620ba-1.text: 3. If a municipal servant dies in connection with the performance of official duties, including after leaving municipal service, the deceased servant’s family members are entitled to a survivor’s pension according to the procedure determined by federal laws.
moscow50-u2bc5b78a0dac9620ba-1.locator: Article 32. Pension provision for a municipal servant and members of their family

moscow50-u9d39232839444ccd28-1.text: 4. A municipal servant retires in the procedure established by federal law.
moscow50-u9d39232839444ccd28-1.locator: Article 32. Pension provision for a municipal servant and members of their family

moscow50-uf73f412e826aea4fc3-1.text: 1. The length (total duration) of municipal service includes periods of holding:

moscow50-u31bb3b7e2cede8dcbf-1.text: 3) state offices of the Russian Federation, state offices of the City of Moscow and state offices of other constituent entities of the Russian Federation;

moscow50-ue7a1b6b6a7ed5655e0-1.text: 4) state civil service positions, military positions, and positions in other types of federal state service;

moscow50-u43f67a7bf9a9c588c2-1.text: 5) other positions in accordance with federal laws.

moscow50-u880adf4aec284de4eb-1.text: 2. In addition to periods in the positions specified in Part 1 of this Article, the length of municipal service used to determine annual additional paid leave for length of service and other guarantees provided for by federal laws, laws of the City of Moscow and charters of municipal formations also includes (credits) periods in positions included (credited) in the length of state civil service under Federal Law No. 79-FZ of 27 July 2004 “On State Civil Service of the Russian Federation” and Law of the City of Moscow No. 11 of 17 May 2000 “On Periods of Service (Work) Taken into Account in Calculating the Length of State Civil Service of the City of Moscow for State Civil Servants of the City of Moscow”.

moscow50-u84998553d5b963d6d8-1.text: 3. For awarding municipal servants a pension for length of service, the length of municipal service includes (credits), in addition to periods in the positions specified in Part 1 of this Article, other periods of employment in accordance with normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and municipal legal acts. Other periods of employment mean periods of work (service) in managerial and specialist positions in organisations where experience and knowledge needed to perform official duties in the municipal service positions held were acquired. The total duration of such other periods may not exceed 50 percent of the municipal servant’s existing length of municipal service and may not exceed five years overall.

moscow50-uec280a20c609ea4ada-1.text: 4. Other periods of employment are included in a municipal servant’s length of municipal service by the municipal formation’s commission for calculating length of service (hereinafter, the service-length commission), established by the representative body.

moscow50-u8eaeed64688ba1125e-1.text: 5. The representative body determines the working procedure of the service-length commission.

moscow50-u3ba5761a1d70285285-1.text: 6. Decisions of the service-length commission are binding on the local self-government body of the corresponding municipal formation from the date the commission adopts them.

moscow50-u4a3d27c1307709a567-1.text: Chapter 7. COMMENDATION OF A MUNICIPAL SERVANT.
moscow50-u4a3d27c1307709a567-1.locator: Chapter 7. COMMENDATION OF A MUNICIPAL SERVANT.

moscow50-u8790107023eed2e7e5-1.text: DISCIPLINARY LIABILITY OF A MUNICIPAL SERVANT
moscow50-u8790107023eed2e7e5-1.locator: Chapter 7. COMMENDATION OF A MUNICIPAL SERVANT.

moscow50-ubd488515ec4dad04af-1.text: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant
moscow50-ubd488515ec4dad04af-1.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant

moscow50-u0c52f2bda537fda1de-1.text: 1. A municipal servant may receive the following rewards for successful and conscientious performance of official duties, long and impeccable service, or performance of assignments of special importance and complexity:
moscow50-u0c52f2bda537fda1de-1.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant

moscow50-u838e87ee921aa599a4-1.text: 1) a declaration of thanks with payment of a lump-sum monetary incentive;
moscow50-u838e87ee921aa599a4-1.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant

moscow50-ue75978c00804238f24-1.text: 2) an honorary certificate of the local self-government body with payment of a lump-sum monetary incentive or presentation of a valuable gift;
moscow50-ue75978c00804238f24-1.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant

moscow50-u1884fddfbd4c83f4c7-1.text: 3) rewards by the Mayor of Moscow, the Government of Moscow or the Moscow City Duma, City of Moscow awards and honorary titles of the City of Moscow, in accordance with laws and other legal acts of the City of Moscow;
moscow50-u1884fddfbd4c83f4c7-1.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant

moscow50-u34f504903133315163-1.text: 4) honorary titles of the Russian Federation and distinctions, orders and medals of the Russian Federation in accordance with federal legislation;
moscow50-u34f504903133315163-1.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant

moscow50-uc4d6b6c181153816cc-1.text: 5) other rewards provided for by municipal legal acts.
moscow50-uc4d6b6c181153816cc-1.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant

moscow50-u1735f913e69298ef35-1.text: 2. The employer’s representative (employer) decides on rewards for a municipal servant in the cases specified in Points 1, 2 and 5 of Part 1 of this Article. Decisions in the cases specified in Points 3 and 4 of Part 1 are made in accordance with federal legislation, laws and other normative legal acts of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-u1735f913e69298ef35-1.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant

moscow50-u4b34c6a48f62264e8b-1.text: 3. The representative body decides on rewards for a municipal servant holding the position of head of administration under contract.
moscow50-u4b34c6a48f62264e8b-1.locator: Article 34. Commendation of a municipal servant

moscow50-u454bde26fcdbb3ffe2-1.text: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant
moscow50-u454bde26fcdbb3ffe2-1.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant

moscow50-udff2ff065c2b34f23d-1.text: 1. For a disciplinary offence — culpable non-performance or improper performance by a municipal servant of their assigned official duties or a breach of labour discipline — the employer’s representative (employer) may impose the following disciplinary sanctions:
moscow50-udff2ff065c2b34f23d-1.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant

moscow50-uf230fd80de0c8e8920-1.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant

moscow50-ufc982edcbafa5c8093-1.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant

moscow50-u5deb2f68467bd34b98-1.text: 3) dismissal from municipal service on the corresponding grounds provided for by federal legislation.
moscow50-u5deb2f68467bd34b98-1.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant

moscow50-ufe7d7cf3bde5ec670d-1.text: 2. A municipal servant who has committed a disciplinary offense may be temporarily suspended from official duties, for no more than one month, pending a decision on disciplinary liability, with retention of monetary remuneration. Such suspension from official duties is effected by a municipal legal act.
moscow50-ufe7d7cf3bde5ec670d-1.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant

moscow50-ubd8f126019b9716e1a-1.text: 3. The procedure for imposing and lifting disciplinary sanctions is determined by labour legislation, except in cases provided for by the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”.
moscow50-ubd8f126019b9716e1a-1.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant

moscow50-u3075c0c68053da90ff-1.text: 4. A disciplinary sanction may be challenged in the procedure established by federal legislation.
moscow50-u3075c0c68053da90ff-1.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant

moscow50-u501d46a2654671050c-1.text: 5. A municipal servant bears liability under federal legislation and laws of the City of Moscow for actions or inaction violating citizens’ rights and legitimate interests.
moscow50-u501d46a2654671050c-1.locator: Article 35. Disciplinary liability of a municipal servant

moscow50-u9517f43702599d4f44-1.text: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes
moscow50-u9517f43702599d4f44-1.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes

moscow50-u2424d87245ba22d729-1.text: 1. Failure by a municipal servant to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or to perform duties established for combating corruption by the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”, the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption”, other federal laws and this Law, results in the sanctions provided for by Article 35 of this Law.
moscow50-u2424d87245ba22d729-1.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes

moscow50-u71aa73a90ae77ae9a0-1.text: 1.1. A municipal servant is exempt from liability for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or to perform duties established by federal laws and this Law for combating corruption, if that failure is recognised as resulting from circumstances beyond the servant’s control in the procedure provided for by Parts 3–6 of Article 13 of the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption”.
moscow50-u71aa73a90ae77ae9a0-1.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes

moscow50-u2b5852abbb515a2641-1.text: 2. A municipal servant shall be dismissed from municipal service due to loss of trust in cases of offences established by Articles 16 and 17 of this Law.
moscow50-u2b5852abbb515a2641-1.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes

moscow50-udcd19efd3307a1c1d4-1.text: 3. The employer’s representative (employer) imposes sanctions provided for by Articles 16, 17 and 35 of this Law in the procedure established by normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and/or municipal legal acts, on the basis of:
moscow50-udcd19efd3307a1c1d4-1.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes

moscow50-u488bd5972be1c350c3-1.text: 1) a report on the results of a check conducted by the relevant local self-government body’s personnel service unit for preventing corruption and other offences, or by the authorised unit of the Administration of the President of the Russian Federation under Article 13.4 of the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption”;
moscow50-u488bd5972be1c350c3-1.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes

moscow50-ufe3091ec64b013992c-1.text: 2) a recommendation of the commission for resolving conflicts of interest where the report on the check results was referred to that commission;
moscow50-ufe3091ec64b013992c-1.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes

moscow50-u151bd2cc298d5c054f-1.text: 2.1) a report by the relevant local self-government body’s personnel service unit for preventing corruption and other offences on a corruption offence, setting out its factual circumstances, and the municipal servant’s written explanation, only with their consent and provided that they acknowledge committing the corruption offence (except where the sanction is dismissal due to loss of trust);
moscow50-u151bd2cc298d5c054f-1.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes

moscow50-ua9d876b0d748f7f6df-1.text: 3) explanations provided by the municipal servant;
moscow50-ua9d876b0d748f7f6df-1.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes

moscow50-u5c79c5e9cc74948cac-1.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes

moscow50-u793958cdba9b738afd-1.text: 4. When sanctions provided for by Articles 16, 17 and 35 of this Law are imposed, account is taken of the nature and gravity of the municipal servant’s corruption offence, the circumstances in which it was committed, compliance with other restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and performance of duties established for combating corruption, as well as previous results of the servant’s performance of official duties.
moscow50-u793958cdba9b738afd-1.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes

moscow50-u11e8e2e706ee216dfb-1.text: 5. An act imposing on a municipal servant sanctions provided for by Articles 16, 17 and 35 of this Law shall cite Part 1 or 2 of Article 27.1 of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation” as the ground for the sanction.
moscow50-u11e8e2e706ee216dfb-1.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes

moscow50-uf9ffa74ebd753db373-1.text: 6. Sanctions provided for by Articles 16, 17 and 35 of this Law are imposed no later than six months after information about the municipal servant’s corruption offence is received, excluding periods of temporary incapacity for work and leave, and no later than three years after the offence was committed. Time spent on criminal proceedings is not included in those periods.
moscow50-uf9ffa74ebd753db373-1.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes

moscow50-u5ed4fe5ab5b84c133b-1.text: 7. Information on dismissal of a municipal servant due to loss of trust is entered by the local self-government body where the servant served into the register of persons dismissed due to loss of trust provided for by Article 15 of the Federal Law “On Combating Corruption”.
moscow50-u5ed4fe5ab5b84c133b-1.locator: Article 35.1. Penalties for failure to comply with restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or settle conflicts of interest, and for failure to perform duties established for anti-corruption purposes

moscow50-ua9f9113382bbfe1649-1.text: Article 36. Suspension from a municipal service position
moscow50-ua9f9113382bbfe1649-1.locator: Article 36. Suspension from a municipal service position

moscow50-u0232acda26b447d14f-1.text: 1. The employer’s representative (employer) must suspend a municipal servant from the municipal service position held (exclude them from performing official duties) in cases provided for by labour legislation.
moscow50-u0232acda26b447d14f-1.locator: Article 36. Suspension from a municipal service position

moscow50-udf1e8f9aeb23feec61-1.text: 2. The employer’s representative (employer) may suspend a municipal servant from the municipal service position held (exclude them from performing official duties) while a conflict of interest is being resolved. The servant retains remuneration throughout the suspension.
moscow50-udf1e8f9aeb23feec61-1.locator: Article 36. Suspension from a municipal service position

moscow50-u07059454ba4e643662-1.text: 3. The employer’s representative (employer) suspends a municipal servant from the municipal service position held (excludes them from performing official duties) for the entire period until circumstances attributable to the servant’s fault that gave grounds for the suspension (exclusion from official duties) have been eliminated.
moscow50-u07059454ba4e643662-1.locator: Article 36. Suspension from a municipal service position

moscow50-uab120668f0796123f0-1.text: 4. During suspension from a municipal service position (exclusion from official duties), no remuneration is accrued to the municipal servant, except in cases provided for by federal laws and this Law.
moscow50-uab120668f0796123f0-1.locator: Article 36. Suspension from a municipal service position
