moscow50-u7ff65e2af6f02a9e88-1.text: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service
moscow50-u7ff65e2af6f02a9e88-1.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service

moscow50-uc7149b11a627fb27ef-1.text: The priority areas for developing the municipal service workforce are:
moscow50-uc7149b11a627fb27ef-1.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service

moscow50-ud3305ec4ee710de7af-1.text: 1) appointing highly qualified specialists to municipal service positions with due regard to their professional qualities and competence;
moscow50-ud3305ec4ee710de7af-1.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service

moscow50-u0c02b98e5d241292c5-1.text: 2) facilitating the career advancement of municipal servants;
moscow50-u0c02b98e5d241292c5-1.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service

moscow50-u98aa8b3ce75213b47b-1.text: 3) training personnel for municipal service and providing additional professional education for municipal servants;
moscow50-u98aa8b3ce75213b47b-1.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service

moscow50-u6bec32a759569a047c-1.text: 4) creating a personnel reserve and using it effectively;
moscow50-u6bec32a759569a047c-1.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service

moscow50-uc3147474b01c3f6c4b-1.text: 5) assessment of municipal servants’ professional level and work results through assessment procedures and qualification examinations;
moscow50-uc3147474b01c3f6c4b-1.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service

moscow50-u47c5c9709c70b899b6-1.text: 6) use of modern personnel selection technologies when citizens enter municipal service and of modern personnel management technologies during service;
moscow50-u47c5c9709c70b899b6-1.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service

moscow50-ubc63e7258990691fcf-1.text: 7) introduction into personnel practice of a rule requiring that a municipal servant’s long and impeccable performance of official duties be taken into account when they are appointed to a higher position, awarded a class rank or rewarded.
moscow50-ubc63e7258990691fcf-1.locator: Article 37. Priority areas in staffing municipal service

moscow50-u56d4f82eab6b89b316-1.text: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies
moscow50-u56d4f82eab6b89b316-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-u42cfd83610c960b89d-1.text: Personnel work in local self-government bodies includes:
moscow50-u42cfd83610c960b89d-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-u960c07c73c6a47e489-1.text: 1) developing the workforce to fill municipal service positions;
moscow50-u960c07c73c6a47e489-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-ufe3680723313659b5c-1.text: 2) preparing proposals for implementing municipal service legislation and submitting those proposals to the employer’s representative (employer);
moscow50-ufe3680723313659b5c-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-ub12a2225b48f3f9aff-1.text: 3) organizing the preparation of draft municipal legal acts connected with entry into and performance of municipal service, conclusion of an employment agreement (contract), appointment to a municipal service position, release from the municipal service position held, dismissal from municipal service and retirement, and preparing the corresponding documents;
moscow50-ub12a2225b48f3f9aff-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-u5543294e16dfd782e9-1.text: 4) maintaining municipal servants’ employment record books, where available, compiling information on their employment activity during municipal service, and submitting that information according to the procedure established by Russian Federation legislation on individual (personalized) record-keeping in the compulsory pension insurance system for storage in the information resources of the Pension and Social Insurance Fund of the Russian Federation;
moscow50-u5543294e16dfd782e9-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-ud80d9e5a2f0b8c165f-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-ue1d0d852225eeacb86-1.text: 6) maintaining the register of municipal servants in the municipality;
moscow50-ue1d0d852225eeacb86-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-ucf3441739159624735-1.text: 7) preparing and issuing municipal servants’ official identity cards;
moscow50-ucf3441739159624735-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-u88dfd7a5ee85d94587-1.text: 8) conducting competitions to fill vacant municipal service positions and including municipal servants in the personnel reserve;
moscow50-u88dfd7a5ee85d94587-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-u1bdf48cc958aacfaef-1.text: 9) conducting assessment procedures and qualification examinations for municipal servants;
moscow50-u1bdf48cc958aacfaef-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-u9b6ae793b3d2c7b40e-1.text: 10) organizing work with the personnel reserve and ensuring its effective use;
moscow50-u9b6ae793b3d2c7b40e-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-ud48723f6d5da1b6921-1.text: 11) organizing and conducting verification of information submitted by a citizen upon entry into municipal service and during the municipal servant’s period of service;
moscow50-ud48723f6d5da1b6921-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-ue847e33624e85e0b72-1.text: 11.1) arranging clearance of the prescribed form to information constituting a state secret;
moscow50-ue847e33624e85e0b72-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-u26bd2f770133b51b23-1.text: 12) organising verification of information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted by municipal servants, and of compliance with municipal service restrictions established by federal legislation and this Law;
moscow50-u26bd2f770133b51b23-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-ua09f776cfbff132205-1.text: 13) advising municipal servants on legal and other matters of municipal service;
moscow50-ua09f776cfbff132205-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-u231424a861723fd5bb-1.text: 14) resolving other personnel matters determined by labour legislation and laws of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-u231424a861723fd5bb-1.locator: Article 38. Personnel work in local self-government bodies

moscow50-u2d97b117546848a6a1-1.text: Article 38.1. Contract-based training of personnel for municipal service
moscow50-u2d97b117546848a6a1-1.locator: Article 38.1. Contract-based training of personnel for municipal service

moscow50-ucfb590d756a0abf562-1.text: 1. To form a highly qualified municipal service workforce, local self-government bodies may organise citizens’ training for municipal service on a contractual basis in accordance with the education legislation of the Russian Federation, taking account of the provisions of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation” and this Law.
moscow50-ucfb590d756a0abf562-1.locator: Article 38.1. Contract-based training of personnel for municipal service

moscow50-u609af5d311bbfe6834-1.text: 2. A targeted education agreement involving an obligation subsequently to perform municipal service is concluded between a local self-government body and a citizen in accordance with the Regulations on the Procedure for Concluding such an Agreement between a Local Self-Government Body and a Citizen, approved by this Law (Appendix 6).
moscow50-u609af5d311bbfe6834-1.locator: Article 38.1. Contract-based training of personnel for municipal service

moscow50-u916b238e62d09761b3-1.text: Article 39. Personal data of a municipal servant
moscow50-u916b238e62d09761b3-1.locator: Article 39. Personal data of a municipal servant

moscow50-ub63befe1e62318435c-1.text: 1. A municipal servant’s personal data means information needed by the employer’s representative (employer) in connection with the servant’s performance of duties in the municipal service position held and concerning that particular servant, including surname, first name, patronymic, day, month, year and place of birth, address, family, social and property status, education, occupation, income and other information.
moscow50-ub63befe1e62318435c-1.locator: Article 39. Personal data of a municipal servant

moscow50-u4ec134001d58db85c6-1.text: 2. A municipal servant’s personal data shall be processed (obtained, stored, combined, transferred and otherwise used) in accordance with labour legislation.
moscow50-u4ec134001d58db85c6-1.locator: Article 39. Personal data of a municipal servant

moscow50-u7b97baeb208487539f-1.text: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file
moscow50-u7b97baeb208487539f-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file

moscow50-uc180ac159a501c825b-1.text: 1. A personal file is created for a municipal servant, containing documents connected with their entry into municipal service, performance of that service and dismissal from it.
moscow50-uc180ac159a501c825b-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file

moscow50-ue6cc0ee47283911187-1.text: 2. If a municipal servant enters municipal service in a local self-government body of another municipal formation or enters state civil service, their personal file is transferred to the new place of service. Maintaining several personal files for the same municipal servant is prohibited.
moscow50-ue6cc0ee47283911187-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file

moscow50-u6b6d52f11ab47bbe6a-1.text: 3. A municipal servant’s personal file is maintained, stored and transferred in the procedure established for maintaining, storing and transferring state civil servants’ personal files.
moscow50-u6b6d52f11ab47bbe6a-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file

moscow50-ue0ba69102a7a393d46-1.text: 4. Collecting information about a municipal servant’s political or religious affiliation or private life and entering it in their personal file are prohibited.
moscow50-ue0ba69102a7a393d46-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file

moscow50-u977d69f8b60e247bff-1.text: 5. At a municipal servant’s request, all materials in their personal file are made available for inspection.
moscow50-u977d69f8b60e247bff-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file

moscow50-ubbd465186b772099a9-1.text: 6. If the local self-government body in which the municipal servant held a municipal service position is dissolved, the personal file is transferred for safekeeping to the local self-government body to which the dissolved body’s functions have been transferred, or to its legal successor.
moscow50-ubbd465186b772099a9-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file

moscow50-ub8a7537606a0701d26-1.text: 7. On a municipal servant’s dismissal, their personal file is kept in the archive of the local self-government body at the last place of municipal service. The file is retained for 10 years from the date of dismissal from municipal service.
moscow50-ub8a7537606a0701d26-1.locator: Article 40. Procedure for maintaining a municipal servant’s personnel file

moscow50-u6a9e4994f03df3c5ba-1.text: 1. A register of municipal servants is maintained in the municipal formation. The procedure for maintaining it is approved by a municipal legal act.

moscow50-ua9e69a5b5a9e19cef5-1.text: 2. Information about municipal servants holding municipal service positions and about persons included in the personnel reserve for vacant municipal service positions is entered in the register of municipal servants.

moscow50-u22e2283a3f170aadb8-1.text: 3. A municipal servant dismissed from municipal service is removed from the register on the dismissal date. A person removed from the personnel reserve for vacant municipal service positions is removed from the register, except where that person is appointed to a municipal service position.

moscow50-u7fd413feb54d9324e3-1.text: 4. If a municipal servant dies (is killed), or is recognized as missing or declared dead by a court decision that has entered into legal force, the servant is removed from the register of municipal servants on the day following death (being killed) or the entry into legal force of the court decision.

moscow50-uc2416ae84b4258b96e-1.text: 5. By agreement between a local self-government body and the authorised executive body of the City of Moscow, information about municipal servants is sent to that executive body for studying and analysing the local self-government body’s personnel composition and for forming the register of municipal servants of municipal service in the City of Moscow.

moscow50-u85095aeb9a9b90373a-1.text: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant
moscow50-u85095aeb9a9b90373a-1.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant

moscow50-ud328d2486b8a69d7a8-1.text: 1. A municipal servant’s additional professional education includes advanced training and professional retraining.
moscow50-ud328d2486b8a69d7a8-1.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant

moscow50-ubf81ed8398668dd01c-1.text: 2. A municipal servant undertakes additional professional education throughout the entire period of municipal service.
moscow50-ubf81ed8398668dd01c-1.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant

moscow50-u70dc1259d664de38f1-1.text: 3. A municipal servant’s advanced training is undertaken as necessary, but at least once every five years.
moscow50-u70dc1259d664de38f1-1.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant

moscow50-u85acc32f3925d5cbd1-1.text: 4. A municipal servant’s additional professional education is provided by organisations delivering additional professional educational programmes.
moscow50-u85acc32f3925d5cbd1-1.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant

moscow50-ufcf1fd6bb89219e5a1-1.text: 5. A municipal servant’s additional professional education may take any form of study provided for by education legislation, with or without release from municipal service.
moscow50-ufcf1fd6bb89219e5a1-1.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant

moscow50-u1a1111f07286487504-1.text: 6. The employer’s representative (employer) determines the type, form and duration of additional professional education according to the group of municipal service positions to which the servant’s position belongs.
moscow50-u1a1111f07286487504-1.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant

moscow50-u97f765792551858854-1.text: 7. A municipal servant sent for additional professional education with release from municipal service retains the position held and remuneration throughout the training period.
moscow50-u97f765792551858854-1.locator: Article 42. Additional professional education of a municipal servant

moscow50-u2c491f27c83c702adc-1.text: Article 43. Personnel reserve in municipal service
moscow50-u2c491f27c83c702adc-1.locator: Article 43. Personnel reserve in municipal service

moscow50-uc9a6ce008d042e63f7-1.text: 1. A personnel reserve for vacant municipal service positions may be established in municipal formations in accordance with municipal legal acts.
moscow50-uc9a6ce008d042e63f7-1.locator: Article 43. Personnel reserve in municipal service

moscow50-u9014a6be4abf258d08-1.text: 2. A municipal servant meeting the qualification requirements for the relevant municipal position is included in the personnel reserve. A person who is not a municipal servant but meets those qualification requirements may also be included in the reserve.
moscow50-u9014a6be4abf258d08-1.locator: Article 43. Personnel reserve in municipal service

moscow50-u0d04739a26d8d9062c-1.text: AND PROGRAMMES FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF MUNICIPAL SERVICE

moscow50-u6c9bcfa213be6ab7d2-1.text: 1. Municipal service is funded from local budgets.

moscow50-u7007031eb7647a9fb1-1.text: 2. The minimum necessary municipal expenditure on municipal service is taken into account in preparing local budgets.

moscow50-u3dda4a755657f8d08b-1.text: 1. The development of municipal service is ensured by municipal programmes for its development and the programme for the development of municipal service in the City of Moscow, funded respectively from local budgets and the budget of the City of Moscow.

moscow50-u490bafbf4ef278d639-1.text: 2. Experiments may be conducted in individual local self-government bodies to improve the efficiency of those bodies and municipal servants. The procedure, conditions and duration of experiments during implementation of the programmes referred to in Part 1 of this Article are established by normative legal acts of the City of Moscow and municipal legal acts.

moscow50-uc6fb7f7e34ed0ce427-1.text: 1. Under this Contract, the Head of Administration undertakes obligations connected with holding the municipal service position of “head of administration” and exercising powers to resolve matters of local significance, as well as individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow (hereinafter, transferred powers).
moscow50-uc6fb7f7e34ed0ce427-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ua0e98b950129ec9b24-1.text: 2. The Head of Administration’s working conditions are determined by the Labour Code of the Russian Federation, taking account of the specific features provided for by Federal Laws No. 131-FZ of 6 October 2003 “On the General Principles of the Organisation of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation” and No. 25-FZ of 2 March 2007 “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”, the Charter of the City of Moscow, Laws of the City of Moscow No. 56 of 6 November 2002 “On the Organisation of Local Self-Government in the City of Moscow” and No. _____ of “___” _________ 200_ “On Municipal Service in the City of Moscow”, the Charter of the municipal formation, and municipal legal acts of the representative body applicable to municipal servants.
moscow50-ua0e98b950129ec9b24-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u44d3029e736cb14d4f-1.text: 3. The Head of Administration is appointed for the term determined by the Charter of the municipal formation in accordance with the Federal Law “On the General Principles of the Organisation of Local Self-Government in the Russian Federation”.
moscow50-u44d3029e736cb14d4f-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u03115f1c385d254f81-1.text: 4. Work under this Contract is the Head of Administration’s principal employment.
moscow50-u03115f1c385d254f81-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ua79203591dad5a7197-1.text: 5. The Head of Administration is a municipal servant, heads the administration of the municipal formation (hereinafter, the administration) on the principle of sole leadership, and independently resolves all matters within their competence.
moscow50-ua79203591dad5a7197-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ua64269327c35364ddb-1.text: 6. The Head of Administration’s workplace is the administration.
moscow50-ua64269327c35364ddb-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u892e20529871c3e9de-1.text: 7. Date on which the Head of Administration begins performing official duties ________________________________.
moscow50-u892e20529871c3e9de-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u08f615db52b35d1a27-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u32040b400d9bf60712-1.text: 2. Powers, rights and duties of the Head of Administration
moscow50-u32040b400d9bf60712-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u7b6067beb6bc72f3ae-1.text: 1. The Head of Administration exercises powers to resolve matters of local significance and to execute transferred powers.
moscow50-u7b6067beb6bc72f3ae-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uaffe3e22fa08ac276b-1.text: 2. When exercising powers on matters of local significance, the Head of Administration shall:
moscow50-uaffe3e22fa08ac276b-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u72515a21304a47fca0-1.text: 1) acquire and exercise property and other rights and obligations on behalf of the administration and appear in court without a power of attorney;
moscow50-u72515a21304a47fca0-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u03a009a93ee63682fb-1.text: 2) in the procedure established by legislation, authorise other persons to acquire and exercise property and other rights and obligations on behalf of the administration and to appear in court on its behalf;
moscow50-u03a009a93ee63682fb-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uccaa7560a057e7de1d-1.text: 3) represent the administration in relations with other local self-government bodies, state authorities of the Russian Federation, state authorities of the City of Moscow, other state bodies, citizens and organisations;
moscow50-uccaa7560a057e7de1d-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u1165945ebb7a599b1e-1.text: 4) within their powers, issue resolutions of the administration on matters of local significance and executive orders of the administration on the organisation of its work;
moscow50-u1165945ebb7a599b1e-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u5dc6a23c903560ce29-1.text: 5) organise and ensure the execution of the administration’s powers to resolve matters of local significance;
moscow50-u5dc6a23c903560ce29-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ub4ca5c386e03667271-1.text: 6) submit the draft budget of the municipal formation (hereinafter, the local budget) and a report on its execution to the representative body for approval;
moscow50-ub4ca5c386e03667271-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uf1a93432429ea8cd59-1.text: 7) submit to the representative body draft decisions providing for expenditure from the local budget and give opinions on such draft decisions;
moscow50-uf1a93432429ea8cd59-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u4d3438faf664ca62f3-1.text: 8) within their powers, organise the implementation of the representative body’s decisions on matters of local significance;
moscow50-u4d3438faf664ca62f3-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ubd42d5b1dde708ff24-1.text: 9) submit the administration’s structure to the representative body for approval;
moscow50-ubd42d5b1dde708ff24-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u9900fbad6997f70463-1.text: 10) appoint and dismiss the deputy head of administration, heads of structural units and other municipal servants in accordance with labour legislation, municipal service legislation and the Charter of the municipal formation, and hire and dismiss administration employees who are not municipal servants;
moscow50-u9900fbad6997f70463-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u27297ead410eb04084-1.text: 11) apply rewards and disciplinary measures to municipal servants and administration employees who are not municipal servants in accordance with labour legislation, municipal service legislation, the Charter of the municipal formation and municipal normative legal acts;
moscow50-u27297ead410eb04084-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u694db9015aef287c3c-1.text: 12) administer local budget funds in accordance with legislation;
moscow50-u694db9015aef287c3c-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uf83775bbe450ce5a00-1.text: 13) organise the management of municipal property in accordance with legislation;
moscow50-uf83775bbe450ce5a00-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u26d8ed5c5b4918079a-1.text: 14) obtain, in the prescribed procedure, information needed for the administration’s work from organisations located within the municipal formation;
moscow50-u26d8ed5c5b4918079a-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ua2f2804f8e3451771a-1.text: 15) organise the reception of citizens and consideration of citizens’ appeals in the administration;
moscow50-ua2f2804f8e3451771a-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ud7ef348d73fb7576b8-1.text: 16) ensure timely and high-quality performance of all the administration’s contracts and other obligations;
moscow50-ud7ef348d73fb7576b8-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uf7020099308bea5126-1.text: 17) ensure the procurement of goods, work and services to meet municipal needs;
moscow50-uf7020099308bea5126-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ud3d0dbfd0e319c73e1-1.text: 18) resolve other matters assigned to their competence by the Charter of the municipal formation and municipal legal acts.
moscow50-ud3d0dbfd0e319c73e1-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u0622d6051c5cfe593e-1.text: 3. When exercising transferred powers, the Head of Administration shall:
moscow50-u0622d6051c5cfe593e-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uc3008961a02cef9aba-2.text: 1) organise and ensure the execution of transferred powers;
moscow50-uc3008961a02cef9aba-2.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uc63fb5bdde98470e4f-2.text: 2) ensure the implementation of legal acts of the City of Moscow concerning transferred powers, including legal acts of authorised executive bodies of the City of Moscow exercising state supervision over local self-government bodies’ exercise of transferred powers;
moscow50-uc63fb5bdde98470e4f-2.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uc3dab2ae07fdb861fa-2.text: 3) submit (ensure the submission of), in the prescribed procedure, to authorised executive bodies of the City of Moscow calculations of the financial costs required to exercise transferred powers, reports on their execution, including the use of financial resources, and other documents and information related to the exercise of transferred powers;
moscow50-uc3dab2ae07fdb861fa-2.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u273cb4fa6edc33ae29-2.text: 4) ensure the designated use and proper maintenance of material resources and the designated use of financial resources provided to local self-government bodies for the exercise of transferred powers;
moscow50-u273cb4fa6edc33ae29-2.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u66e8a4ef449fb642ce-2.text: 5) ensure the return to the budget of the City of Moscow of interbudgetary transfers received as subventions and not used in the current financial year;
moscow50-u66e8a4ef449fb642ce-2.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uff574275ec6fd9166e-2.text: 6) be entitled to request and receive from state authorities of the City of Moscow information concerning the performance of transferred powers, including explanations and recommendations on their exercise;
moscow50-uff574275ec6fd9166e-2.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ubda008b74386a18845-2.text: 7) ensure conditions for state supervisory bodies to supervise the administration’s execution of transferred powers as regards the designated expenditure of financial resources, and to conduct legal examination and analysis of the administration’s legal acts adopted on matters concerning transferred powers, in the forms provided for by legal acts of the City of Moscow;
moscow50-ubda008b74386a18845-2.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ua7f4ff9e65990e37a1-2.text: 8) within their powers, issue administration resolutions on matters concerning the exercise of transferred powers;
moscow50-ua7f4ff9e65990e37a1-2.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ub4f748f5b985c0bba9-2.text: 9) exercise other powers established by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-ub4f748f5b985c0bba9-2.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u51b06ae65d8e882877-1.text: 3. Remuneration of the Head of Administration
moscow50-u51b06ae65d8e882877-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u86b5b24d9f2ce8e4ce-1.text: 1. The Head of Administration is paid remuneration comprising:
moscow50-u86b5b24d9f2ce8e4ce-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u6be0855719c227b8b7-1.text: an official salary corresponding to the municipal service position held (hereinafter, official salary), amounting to ___________ roubles per month <1>;
moscow50-u6be0855719c227b8b7-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u067262119a1a073bb3-1.text: a monthly official salary supplement for class rank amounting to _________ roubles per month;
moscow50-u067262119a1a073bb3-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u1e835efec3d28ab601-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u6e4a038307dba41183-1.text: a monthly supplement for length of service amounting to _________ roubles per month;
moscow50-u6e4a038307dba41183-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ue7b71f54883c60157a-1.text: a monthly supplement for special municipal service conditions amounting to _________ roubles per month;
moscow50-ue7b71f54883c60157a-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ueacfe5dc9488ad6516-1.text: bonuses for performing especially important and complex assignments;
moscow50-ueacfe5dc9488ad6516-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ua8fe3b66e197e23f4a-1.text: a lump-sum payment for regular annual paid leave;
moscow50-ua8fe3b66e197e23f4a-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u08a93a64ca7b7ca721-1.text: other monthly and additional payments in accordance with federal legislation, laws of the City of Moscow and the Charter of the municipal formation.
moscow50-u08a93a64ca7b7ca721-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u4835a3104cc7f4f978-1.text: <1> In municipal formations receiving grants from the budget of the City of Moscow to equalise budgetary capacity, the official salary of the head of administration is set at a level not exceeding the official salary of the head of a district board.
moscow50-u4835a3104cc7f4f978-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u4594d00b169ec7f987-1.text: 2. The representative body independently establishes the amount and terms of the Head of Administration’s pay in accordance with federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-u4594d00b169ec7f987-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u5814844ed45c22fbdc-1.text: 3. The Head of Administration’s remuneration is indexed or increased by the corresponding amounts and at the times established for state civil servants of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-u5814844ed45c22fbdc-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u49973ba2020295c7ee-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u3951b4094346da53ef-1.text: 1. The Head of Administration’s working (service) time is regulated in accordance with labour legislation and federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow on municipal service.
moscow50-u3951b4094346da53ef-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ud208edc58900332430-1.text: 2. The Head of Administration is granted annual basic paid leave of 30 calendar days, with retention of the municipal service position held and remuneration.
moscow50-ud208edc58900332430-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ubb02fc483c97f906a4-1.text: 3. The Head of Administration is granted annual additional paid leave for length of service (no more than 10 calendar days) and in the cases provided for by federal laws and laws of the City of Moscow.
moscow50-ubb02fc483c97f906a4-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uc33aef01a72e5e88c4-1.text: 4. The durations of annual basic paid leave and annual additional paid leave are added together to form annual paid leave, which may be granted in parts at the Head of Administration’s request. One part of the annual paid leave granted must be no shorter than 14 calendar days.
moscow50-uc33aef01a72e5e88c4-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u849613fa69f47a7a70-1.text: 5. On the Head of Administration’s written application, the Employer’s Representative may decide to grant unpaid leave in the cases provided for by federal laws.
moscow50-u849613fa69f47a7a70-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u1dd34f367a78f57538-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u913a6efde2596674ce-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ua19a273aaefff0d5ac-1.text: <2> Under Part 8 of Article 20 of Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 “On Municipal Service in the City of Moscow”, the contract is concluded for the term of office of the representative body that decided to appoint the person as head of administration (until the day the newly elected representative body begins its work), but for no less than two years.
moscow50-ua19a273aaefff0d5ac-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u94687f353d1911ec7d-1.text: 2. The Head of Administration’s powers terminate when this Contract expires or early in accordance with federal laws, laws of the City of Moscow and the Charter of the municipal formation.
moscow50-u94687f353d1911ec7d-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ufa0738f732fb7af1a4-1.text: 3. On termination of municipal service, the Head of Administration must return to the administration all documents containing official information and transfer official affairs to their successor in the prescribed procedure.
moscow50-ufa0738f732fb7af1a4-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u52c2fd3412487188bb-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u010f4f11f0d97178e0-1.text: 1. The Parties are liable under legislation for failure to perform and/or improper performance of the terms of this Contract.
moscow50-u010f4f11f0d97178e0-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u31ed64876dd60a8dc0-1.text: 2. The Head of Administration is liable for failure to perform their duties, including as regards individual state powers transferred to local self-government bodies, in the procedure and on the terms established by federal laws, laws of the City of Moscow and the Charter of the municipal formation.
moscow50-u31ed64876dd60a8dc0-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u1ac5bf16c79400f53d-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u8a6a7b037526e7c63a-1.text: Disputes and disagreements under this Contract are resolved by agreement between the Parties or, if no agreement is reached, in the procedure provided for by federal legislation.
moscow50-u8a6a7b037526e7c63a-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ub05d21f0af5488c962-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u25eec50a6764fff2e2-1.text: 1. This Contract enters into force on the date it is signed by both Parties and terminates after the Head of Administration’s powers end.
moscow50-u25eec50a6764fff2e2-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u1f3384dc13e2a0a20a-1.text: 2. On matters not regulated by this Contract, the Parties are guided by labour legislation and municipal service legislation.
moscow50-u1f3384dc13e2a0a20a-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ub4c11e0adbdea594db-1.text: 3. Either Party may raise with the other the issue of amending (clarifying) or supplementing this Contract; such changes are formalised as written supplementary agreements forming an integral part of this Contract.
moscow50-ub4c11e0adbdea594db-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u2cd8553cb5e349c4f8-1.text: 4. The terms of this Contract may be changed only if labour legislation, municipal service legislation or the Charter of the municipal formation changes.
moscow50-u2cd8553cb5e349c4f8-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uea7e0951226a24ec31-1.text: 5. This Contract is drawn up in two counterparts of equal legal force. One is kept by the Employer’s Representative in the Head of Administration’s personal file, and the other by the Head of Administration.
moscow50-uea7e0951226a24ec31-1.locator: Appendix 1 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u1ec36d90563d48e82b-1.text: OF LOCAL SELF-GOVERNMENT BODIES OF INTRA-CITY
moscow50-u1ec36d90563d48e82b-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uf56163d774bc8c07e0-1.text: MUNICIPAL FORMATIONS IN THE CITY OF MOSCOW
moscow50-uf56163d774bc8c07e0-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u59747bc9e8cd92744f-2.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u4081befdb46749fddb-1.text: 1. These Regulations determine the procedure for assessing municipal servants of local self-government bodies of an intra-city municipal formation in the City of Moscow (hereinafter, municipal servants).
moscow50-u4081befdb46749fddb-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u5aacc8757be97231f8-1.text: 2. Assessment of a municipal servant (hereinafter, assessment) is conducted to determine their suitability for the municipal service position held. Assessment is intended to contribute to forming the municipal service workforce and improving municipal servants’ professional level.
moscow50-u5aacc8757be97231f8-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u4f1d5ffa02dd665899-1.text: 3. Assessment is conducted once every three years.
moscow50-u4f1d5ffa02dd665899-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u544a2901ff94889522-1.text: 4. The following municipal servants are not subject to assessment:
moscow50-u544a2901ff94889522-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u006aad4e365869ec8a-2.text: 1) those who have held municipal service positions for less than one year;
moscow50-u006aad4e365869ec8a-2.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u0c0705c959c3d7f056-2.text: 2) those who have reached the age of 60;
moscow50-u0c0705c959c3d7f056-2.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-udbd38c668a0a2626c9-2.text: 3) those on maternity leave or on leave to care for a child until the child reaches the age of three. Such municipal servants may be appraised no earlier than one year after returning from leave;
moscow50-udbd38c668a0a2626c9-2.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u7a4d74e69be47b0602-2.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u09a26780590b6d3fd3-1.text: 5) those with whom a fixed-term employment agreement (contract) has been concluded;
moscow50-u09a26780590b6d3fd3-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u0da1f2a968bce7887b-2.text: 6) those within one year after being awarded a class rank.
moscow50-u0da1f2a968bce7887b-2.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u87d825e0baa9e29496-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u8e2e72f8c8e4ba5412-1.text: 1. To conduct assessment, a municipal legal act is issued by decision of the employer’s representative (employer), containing provisions on:
moscow50-u8e2e72f8c8e4ba5412-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u706dc5dec4cbaf8dfd-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u4a872bc6f62afbeedf-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u67f14c08bac55a251b-1.text: 3) preparation of the list of municipal servants subject to assessment;
moscow50-u67f14c08bac55a251b-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uf25eed40f3da19c824-1.text: 4) preparation of documents needed for the assessment commission’s work.
moscow50-uf25eed40f3da19c824-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uaf2e593bb87f25417b-1.text: 2. The assessment commission includes the employer’s representative (employer) and/or municipal servants authorised by that representative (including personnel and legal service staff).
moscow50-uaf2e593bb87f25417b-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ua31c64dd5e00d9de3f-1.text: The assessment commission may include representatives of scientific and educational organisations and other organisations invited by the employer’s representative (employer) as independent experts specialising in municipal service matters, without specifying their personal data. Independent experts must constitute at least one quarter of the total membership of the assessment commission.
moscow50-ua31c64dd5e00d9de3f-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u3b6082237d47419768-1.text: 3. The assessment commission for municipal servants whose official duties involve the use of information constituting state secrets or other secrets protected by federal laws is formed taking account of federal legislation on state secrets.
moscow50-u3b6082237d47419768-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u584a5a23cd263728ed-1.text: 4. The assessment commission consists of a chair, deputy chair, secretary and commission members.
moscow50-u584a5a23cd263728ed-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u698448230f51ea2cfe-1.text: All assessment commission members have equal rights in decision-making. A meeting is quorate if at least two thirds of the total commission membership are present.
moscow50-u698448230f51ea2cfe-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u93a91f0505180bb220-1.text: A municipal servant’s membership of the assessment commission is suspended for the period of that servant’s assessment.
moscow50-u93a91f0505180bb220-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u22afc70468853d49c0-1.text: 5. When municipal servants holding principal municipal service positions are assessed, the head of the municipal formation and a representative of the authorised executive body of the City of Moscow may be included in the assessment commission.
moscow50-u22afc70468853d49c0-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ud2a0504427c79b7379-1.text: 6. Assessment is conducted according to an assessment schedule specifying:
moscow50-ud2a0504427c79b7379-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u688bce36d2f65d9dd8-1.text: 1) the list of municipal servants subject to assessment;
moscow50-u688bce36d2f65d9dd8-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ucd81c893f68ad60acf-1.text: 2) the date, time and place of assessment;
moscow50-ucd81c893f68ad60acf-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u6896909db4516c91a2-1.text: 3) the date for submitting to the assessment commission a report on the municipal servant’s professional activity (hereinafter, the report), specifying the head of the relevant local self-government body unit responsible for submitting it.
moscow50-u6896909db4516c91a2-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ubb96c9bfac4190ec90-1.text: 7. The assessment schedule is communicated to each municipal servant subject to assessment against signature at least 30 days before assessment begins.
moscow50-ubb96c9bfac4190ec90-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ud27f69ebd9150fc6f6-1.text: 8. At least 14 days before assessment begins, a report for the assessment period signed by the immediate head of the unit where the municipal servant works (hereinafter, the manager) is submitted to the assessment commission.
moscow50-ud27f69ebd9150fc6f6-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u6293a64b93e9b13eef-1.text: 9. The report must contain the following information:
moscow50-u6293a64b93e9b13eef-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ud24904ca7cb5d5b743-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u3ad96b94bd65c076c1-1.text: 2) the municipal service position held at the time of assessment and the date of appointment to that position;
moscow50-u3ad96b94bd65c076c1-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uc82cbef93ea21e24f1-1.text: 3) a list of the main matters (documents) in whose resolution (development) the municipal servant participated;
moscow50-uc82cbef93ea21e24f1-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u999274427cbd7f6b42-1.text: 4) a reasoned assessment of the municipal servant’s professional, business and personal qualities and professional activity results.
moscow50-u999274427cbd7f6b42-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ufa81a1d33fefe02ea7-1.text: 10. At each subsequent assessment, the municipal servant’s assessment sheet containing the previous assessment results is also submitted to the assessment commission.
moscow50-ufa81a1d33fefe02ea7-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u76c0d9d9ecb74e87f1-1.text: 11. At least 7 days before assessment begins, the personnel service of the local self-government body must familiarise every municipal servant subject to assessment with the report submitted for their assessment period. The servant may send the assessment commission additional information on their professional activity during that period, a written statement disagreeing with the report, or an explanatory note concerning it.
moscow50-u76c0d9d9ecb74e87f1-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u15bbdb1f640cbdf815-1.text: 12. The assessment commission may postpone assessment to another day if:
moscow50-u15bbdb1f640cbdf815-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u2b18a34315217a1753-1.text: 1) on the assessment date, the municipal servant submits additional information on their professional activity during the assessment period;
moscow50-u2b18a34315217a1753-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ub44d660cc8d1783713-1.text: 2) the municipal servant has submitted a written statement disagreeing with the manager’s report;
moscow50-ub44d660cc8d1783713-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u96bee423af721fcffd-1.text: 3) the municipal servant fails to attend the assessment commission meeting for a valid reason.
moscow50-u96bee423af721fcffd-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ub2d1b565ad1cc7362f-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uc71bbc6774f92d8b76-1.text: 1. Assessment is conducted with the municipal servant being assessed invited to the commission meeting. If the servant fails to attend without a valid reason or refuses assessment, disciplinary liability is imposed in accordance with federal municipal service legislation and the assessment is postponed to a later date.
moscow50-uc71bbc6774f92d8b76-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u38d302a8d809454497-1.text: 2. The assessment commission examines the submitted documents and hears statements by the municipal servant being assessed or, where necessary, their manager concerning the servant’s professional activity.
moscow50-u38d302a8d809454497-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ueace6e91ae0e706892-1.text: 3. Discussion of the municipal servant’s professional, business and personal qualities in relation to their professional activity must be objective and benevolent.
moscow50-ueace6e91ae0e706892-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uf8e54b8d8ee4876518-1.text: 4. Discussion of matters concerning a municipal servant’s private life or their attitude towards political or religious organisations is prohibited.
moscow50-uf8e54b8d8ee4876518-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uf7202964eb92ba610b-1.text: 5. If additional time is needed for objective consideration of supplementary information submitted by the municipal servant about their professional service activity during the assessment period, the commission may postpone assessment until its next meeting.
moscow50-uf7202964eb92ba610b-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u5cd32a316aaca6ef56-1.text: 6. When deciding whether a municipal servant is suitable for the position held, the assessment commission must take account of:
moscow50-u5cd32a316aaca6ef56-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ue3158aa2738515d19b-1.text: 1) their level of education and professional knowledge;
moscow50-ue3158aa2738515d19b-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u1085e48982bcc8eb45-1.text: 2) the extent of the servant’s professional contribution to resolving the tasks assigned to the relevant local self-government body unit;
moscow50-u1085e48982bcc8eb45-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u40ca29431b5d6a52a7-1.text: 3) the complexity and effectiveness of the servant’s work;
moscow50-u40ca29431b5d6a52a7-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uf4e6fcca9cbe06090a-1.text: 4) the servant’s compliance with statutory municipal service prohibitions and restrictions and official conduct requirements;
moscow50-uf4e6fcca9cbe06090a-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u631bcd19d3f173119e-1.text: 5) organisational abilities, when assessing a servant vested with organisational and administrative powers over other municipal servants.
moscow50-u631bcd19d3f173119e-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u28b99088ceffc3f64c-1.text: 7. The assessment commission secretary keeps minutes recording the voting results and the commission’s decision. The minutes are signed by the chair, deputy chair, secretary and commission members present at the meeting.
moscow50-u28b99088ceffc3f64c-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u575659a4c71234092e-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ubccbb6542b56bde40e-1.text: 1. Following assessment, the commission decides whether the municipal servant is or is not suitable for the municipal service position held.
moscow50-ubccbb6542b56bde40e-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uc2817aaf41037aff3f-1.text: 2. The assessment commission may recommend rewards, including promotion, for individual municipal servants’ achievements at work and, where necessary, improvements to the work of those assessed. It may also recommend, on the basis of assessment results, that individual servants be sent for additional professional education.
moscow50-uc2817aaf41037aff3f-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u52a62c82a2ac3c8599-1.text: 3. The assessment commission decides in the absence of the municipal servant being assessed, by open vote and a simple majority of members present at the meeting. If votes are equal, the servant is deemed suitable for the municipal service position held.
moscow50-u52a62c82a2ac3c8599-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u0aa09de831054c51c2-1.text: 4. Assessment results are communicated to the servants assessed immediately after the voting results are finalised.
moscow50-u0aa09de831054c51c2-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u2af49fb12ffeccf74a-1.text: 5. Assessment results (the decision and recommendations) are entered in the municipal servant’s assessment sheet (hereinafter, the assessment sheet). The sheet is signed by the chair, deputy chair, secretary and commission members present at the meeting.
moscow50-u2af49fb12ffeccf74a-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u038138dffe2f8492eb-1.text: 6. Assessment materials are forwarded to the employer’s representative (employer) no later than seven days after assessment.
moscow50-u038138dffe2f8492eb-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ubcfc727b389090dea6-1.text: 7. A municipal servant is entitled to challenge the appraisal results in court.
moscow50-ubcfc727b389090dea6-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uc9f259d8c90e0a1be3-1.text: 8. The assessment sheet, report, supplementary information submitted by the servant about professional activity during the assessment period, and any statement disagreeing with the report or explanatory note concerning it are kept in the servant’s personal file.
moscow50-uc9f259d8c90e0a1be3-1.locator: Appendix 2 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uea6de48df3a30f2af6-1.text: ON THE PROCEDURE FOR CONCLUDING BETWEEN A LOCAL
moscow50-uea6de48df3a30f2af6-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ucaea435560dbfaff84-1.text: SELF-GOVERNMENT BODY AND A CITIZEN A TARGETED EDUCATION AGREEMENT
moscow50-ucaea435560dbfaff84-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u4be070b1577ec40b5f-1.text: WITH AN OBLIGATION SUBSEQUENTLY TO PERFORM
moscow50-u4be070b1577ec40b5f-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ub80017c1bf7fc64e20-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ubd023a24c4b2bddabd-1.text: 1. A targeted education agreement involving an obligation subsequently to perform municipal service (hereinafter, a targeted education agreement) is concluded between a local self-government body and a competitively selected citizen studying at a state higher education institution or a vocational educational institution with state accreditation for the relevant educational programme (hereinafter, the educational institution). It provides for the citizen’s obligation to perform municipal service in that local self-government body for a specified period after completing their studies.
moscow50-ubd023a24c4b2bddabd-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u18263ef686f327aa6c-1.text: 2. Citizens who have command of the state language of the Russian Federation, are obtaining vocational or higher education at the relevant level for the first time, and have no obligations under an apprenticeship or other agreement entailing employment relations after graduation are entitled to participate in the competition for a targeted education agreement (hereinafter, the competition).
moscow50-u18263ef686f327aa6c-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u63162dcd40f00685c3-1.text: 3. A citizen participating in the competition must, when entering municipal service and throughout the mandatory period of municipal service following targeted education established by the agreement, meet the requirements for the relevant municipal service positions established by Federal Law No. 25-FZ of 2 March 2007 “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation” and Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008 “On Municipal Service in the City of Moscow”.
moscow50-u63162dcd40f00685c3-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u25ab4886df7ef38e38-1.text: 4. The representative body of local self-government decides to hold the competition. The competition is conducted by a competition commission whose formation and working procedure are established by that representative body.
moscow50-u25ab4886df7ef38e38-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u017566739c37eb8651-1.text: 5. Information about the competition must be published in the print medium used for official publication of municipal legal acts and posted on the local self-government body’s official website on the Internet information and telecommunications network at least one month before the competition date. It must include:
moscow50-u017566739c37eb8651-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ua9dec61c6341a605d0-1.text: 1) the municipal service positions to be filled by citizens after graduation;
moscow50-ua9dec61c6341a605d0-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u8646ea14b70bb62a04-1.text: 2) qualification requirements for municipal service positions (requirements concerning the level of vocational or higher education, field of study, knowledge and skills needed to perform official duties and, where the employer’s representative (employer) has made the relevant decision, speciality and field of study);
moscow50-u8646ea14b70bb62a04-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u9d4e04a17c104c79a8-1.text: 3) the list of documents to be submitted for the competition under Point 6 of these Regulations;
moscow50-u9d4e04a17c104c79a8-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uafeb61044f0403fbe8-1.text: 4) the place, opening and closing dates and hours for accepting documents;
moscow50-uafeb61044f0403fbe8-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u9f30a0fbedbd157e61-1.text: 5) the competition date, time, place and procedure. The competition announcement may also contain other information and informational materials.
moscow50-u9f30a0fbedbd157e61-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ueb88a0e31b88bbc1ea-1.text: 6. A citizen wishing to participate in the competition submits to the local self-government body:
moscow50-ueb88a0e31b88bbc1ea-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ud983b9d594fece0363-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ud0f66b64d45810a839-1.text: 2) the questionnaire provided for by Article 15.2 of the Federal Law “On Municipal Service in the Russian Federation”, with a photograph attached;
moscow50-ud0f66b64d45810a839-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u2ca18978427e2945bd-1.text: 3) a copy of the passport (the passport is presented in person on arrival for the competition);
moscow50-u2ca18978427e2945bd-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u236fe20e077828066d-1.text: 4) a copy of the employment record book and/or information on employment history prepared in the procedure established by labour legislation, or other documents confirming the citizen’s employment (service) activity, except where no such activity has previously been performed;
moscow50-u236fe20e077828066d-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u03266ff730d3697007-1.text: 5) a medical organisation’s conclusion confirming the absence of a disease preventing entry into and performance of municipal service;
moscow50-u03266ff730d3697007-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-ue0880a37068efd2518-1.text: 6) a certificate from the educational institution confirming that the citizen is obtaining secondary vocational or higher education for the first time through full-time study at that institution funded from budgets of the budgetary system of the Russian Federation. It must also contain information on the educational programme being undertaken (specifying the occupation, speciality or field of study) and the results of interim assessments under the curriculum. The citizen may submit other documents not specified in this Point characterising their personal and business qualities.
moscow50-ue0880a37068efd2518-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uae1ce6b93403370699-1.text: 7. The competition commission assesses applicants for targeted education agreements on the basis of the documents specified in Point 6 of these Regulations and the competition procedures’ results. By decision of the local self-government body, those procedures may include individual interviews, questionnaires, testing, preparation of an essay and other procedures not contrary to federal laws or other normative legal acts. The representative body of local self-government determines the methodology for the competition procedures, including applicant assessment criteria.
moscow50-uae1ce6b93403370699-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-uf1084659b9a770cb1d-1.text: 8. Citizens who participated in the competition are informed of its results in writing no later than 10 days after its completion.
moscow50-uf1084659b9a770cb1d-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008

moscow50-u44626da33fe9c46536-1.text: 9. A targeted education agreement between the local self-government body and a competitively selected citizen is concluded in writing no later than 45 days after the decision on the competition results is adopted.
moscow50-u44626da33fe9c46536-1.locator: Appendix 6 to Law of the City of Moscow No. 50 of 22 October 2008
